blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Robotic perception increasingly relies on heterogeneous sensor suites combining cameras with emerging modalities (event, SPAD, iToF/dToF, and thermal). Yet existing simulators idealize these sensors, hiding critical modality-specific failure modes that limit real-world deployment. We present VisionSIM, a unified, physically grounded simulation platform that elevates sensor realism to a first-class concern by modeling the raw physical measurement process for diverse conventional and emerging modalities. We expose fine-grained control over physical sensor parameters, reproducing failure modes overlooked by general-purpose simulators: pileup and glare for LiDAR; phase wrapping, saturation, and motion artifacts for iToF; refractory drops for event cameras; and history-dependent emission for thermal cameras. This enables principled cross-modality comparison on identical scenes and trajectories. We release the platform and a large indoor dataset with synchronized raw measurements and rich ground-truth annotations.
blocks.zh: 机器人感知越来越依赖于将相机与新兴模式(活动、SPAD、iToF/dToF和热能)相结合的各种传感器套件。 然而现有的模拟器将这些传感器理想化,隐藏了限制现实世界部署的关键模式特定故障模式. 我们提出VisionSIM,这是一个统一的、以物理为基础的模拟平台,通过模拟各种常规和新兴模式的原始物理测量过程,将传感器现实主义提升到一流的关注。 我们揭露了对物理传感器参数的精细控制,复制了被通用模拟器忽略的故障模式:LiDAR的堆积和闪光;iToF的相位包装、饱和度和运动文物;事件摄像头的可逆滴;热相机的依赖历史的排放。 这使得能够就相同的场景和轨迹进行原则性的跨模式比较。 我们发布平台和大型室内数据集,同时提供同步原始测量和丰富的地面真实性说明.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A robotics simulator presented with a scene will typically render a sharp, noise-free image. Yet, the same scene captured by a real conventional camera might show heavy motion blur from a long exposure; a real single-photon LiDAR aimed at a retroreflective object might report a phantom obstacle in front of it; a long-wave infrared (LWIR) thermal camera will show a lingering thermal footprint of a warm handprint on a desk or a radiator still glowing minutes after shutoff. These are not exotic edge cases — they are the operating conditions that decide whether a deployed robot succeeds or fails. However, they are largely absent from today’s general-purpose robotics simulators.
blocks.zh: 一个带场景的机器人模拟器一般会制作出尖锐而无噪声的图像. 然而,被真正的常规相机所摄取的同样场景可能从长时间的照射中显示出了沉重的运动模糊;以反光物体为对象的一副真正的单相光LiDAR可能会报告其前方存在幻影障碍;长波红外相机会显示一个桌上或关闭后几分钟仍然发光的散热器上留有的热脚印. 这些不是异地边缘情况,而是决定部署的机器人成败的操作条件。 然而,它们基本上没有出现在今天的通用机器人模拟器中.

blocks.en: Modern simulation platforms have transformed how robots are trained, evaluated, and deployed: physics engines such as MuJoCo [ 93 ] , Isaac Gym [ 54 ] , and Genesis [ 3 ] model rigid-body dynamics with impressive fidelity, while rendering engines such as Unreal [ 22 ] and Blender [ 14 ] bring photorealistic digital twins of factories and cities within reach. However, these platforms share a critical blind spot: they do not faithfully simulate how agents actually see the world . Real-world agents act on what their sensors deliver, not on ground truth, and typically combine multiple complementary sensors (Table 1 ). Yet most simulation engines do not support the necessary breadth of sensors, or they model them only superficially: ideal cameras in a well-lit environment, LiDARs as noiseless range-finders, IMUs as perfect integrators, thermal cameras as static temperature textures. Such simplifications ignore the noise, motion blur, and modality-specific artifacts that dominate real measurements — from glare and pileup in single-photon LiDAR [ 31 ] to the geometry-, material-, and history-dependent emission that defines real thermal imagery.
blocks.zh: 现代模拟平台改变了机器人的培训,评价和部署方式:MujoCo [93],Isaac Gym [54]等物理引擎,以及具有令人印象深刻的忠诚的"创世纪"[3]模型刚性-身体动力学,同时渲染出Unreal [22]和Blender [14]等引擎,将工厂和城市的光现实主义数字双胞胎带入可及范围. 然而,这些平台有一个关键的盲点:它们不忠实地模拟代理商如何看待世界。 现实世界的代理人按其传感器所传递的,而不是根据地面的真相行事,通常结合多种互补传感器(表1)。 然而,大多数模拟引擎并不支持传感器的必要宽度,或者它们只是表面模拟:光线良好的环境中的理想相机,LiDARs作为无噪音的射程探测器,IMU作为完美的整流器,热相机作为静温纹理. 这种简化忽略了影响真实测量的噪音,运动模糊和特定模式的文物——从光泽和单相光LiDAR [31]的堆积到定义真实热成像的几何,材料和历史所依赖的排放.

blocks.en: Existing efforts address this gap only partially. Sensor-specific simulators, such as ESIM [ 71 ] and v2e [ 35 ] for event cameras, are highly specialized and cannot support cross-modality comparisons. Physically-based infrared generators such as MuSES [ 96 ] and DIRSIG [ 81 ] couple heat-transfer solvers to radiometric rendering, but target terrain-scale signature prediction driven by weather and atmospheric models, rather than the object-scale thermal phenomena central to embodied perception. General-purpose platforms such as CARLA [ 20 ] , AirSim [ 82 ] , Isaac Gym [ 54 ] , and Habitat [ 77 ] expand sensor coverage but inherit the same idealizations. As a result, robot system architects cannot compare candidate sensor suites on common ground without expensive hardware prototyping.
blocks.zh: 现有努力只是部分弥补了这一差距。 传感器特有模拟器,如事件相机的ESIM [71]和v2e [35],都是高度专业化的,不能支持跨模式比较. 基于物理的红外发生器,如MuSES[96]和DIRSIG[81]对等热能传输解析器进行辐射度渲染,但受天气和大气模型所驱动的目标地形尺度特征预测,而不是对所体现感知至关重要的物体尺度热现象. CARLA [20], AirSim [82], Isaac Gym [54]等通用平台,以及Hibit [77] 扩展了传感器覆盖范围,但继承了相同的理想化. 因此,没有昂贵的硬件原型,机器人系统建筑师无法在平地上比较候选传感器套房.

blocks.en: Our guiding hypothesis is that a high-fidelity simulator must model not just world physics and geometry, but also perception itself — with realistic sensors that bridge photons to measurement. To this end, we present VisionSIM, a unified, physically grounded sensor simulation platform for robotics that aims to elevate sensor realism to a first-class concern, on par with scene and physics modeling (Figure 1 ). VisionSIM is built around the following key design goals:
blocks.zh: 我们的指导假设是,高真度模拟器必须不仅模拟世界物理和几何,而且模拟感知本身——用现实的传感器将光子相接来测量. 为此,我们介绍了VisionSIM,这是一个统一的、有实体基础的机器人传感器模拟平台,目的是将传感器现实主义提升到一等的关注点,与场景和物理建模一样(图1)。 愿景SIM围绕以下关键设计目标构建:

blocks.en: Breadth across conventional and emerging sensors. VisionSIM simulates conventional and high-speed cameras, stereo rigs, passive single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) cameras, direct and indirect time-of-flight (dToF/iToF) LiDARs, event cameras, long-wave infrared (LWIR) thermal cameras, and inertial measurement units (Table 1 ). Candidate sensor suites can be evaluated on identical scenes and trajectories, enabling principled comparisons across a wide range of sensors.
blocks.zh: 穿透传统和新兴传感器 VisionSIM模拟常规相机和高速相机,立体钻机,被动单相机雪崩二极管相机,直接和间接飞行时间(dTOF/iTOF)LiDARs,事件相机,长波红外相机(LWIR)热相机,惯性测量单元(表1). 可以在相同的场景和轨迹上评价候选的传感器套房,从而能够在广泛的传感器中进行原则性比较。

blocks.en: High physical fidelity, including failure modes. VisionSIM emulates raw measurements for each modality (e.g., transient histograms, correlation taps, and asynchronous brightness changes). This naturally reproduces key failure modes: SPAD pileup and glare; iToF wrapping and motion artifacts; event refractory limits; and path-tracing-coupled dynamic thermal heat transport, capturing failure modes that, to our knowledge, lie beyond the reach of existing general-purpose simulators.
blocks.zh: 身体高度忠诚,包括失败模式。 VisionSIM对每种模式进行原始测量(例如:瞬态直方图、相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干 这自然地复制出关键故障模式:SPAD堆积和闪光;iToF包接和运动文物;事件可折射极限;和路径追踪相接的动态热能传输,捕捉到据我们所知是现有通用模拟器无法达到的故障模式.

blocks.en: Fine-grained control over sensing parameters. VisionSIM exposes the physical parameters that govern each modality’s measurement process (Table 2 ): iToF correlation functions; event contrast thresholds; dead time and quantum efficiency for SPADs; microbolometer thermal time constants, and per-surface emissivity for thermal cameras; exposure, gain, and ISP parameters for conventional cameras. This parameterization lets a user not only sweep across sensor designs, but also match the simulator to a specific physical device — the basis for calibrated perceptual digital twins.
blocks.zh: 精细控制感知参数. VisionSIM揭示了规范每种模式的测量过程的物理参数(表2):iToF相关性函数;事件对比阈值;SPAD的死活时间和量子效率;微波计热时常数,以及热相机的地表发射率;常规相机的曝光,增益和ISP参数. 这种参数化让用户不仅可以横扫传感器设计,还可以将模拟器与特定的物理设备相匹配——这是被校准的知觉数码双胞胎的基础.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Multi-modal, high-fidelity and controllable sensor emulation. Robotic simulation pipelines often focus on scene content, overlooking physically accurate sensor modeling. VisionSIM aims to bridge this gap by emulating diverse sensor types and their failure modes. (Top) A single scene is rendered once with dense ground truth — color, depth, optical flow, surface normals, segmentation, point map, direct and indirect illumination, and a temperature map. (Middle) The same scene is then replayed through a breadth of sensor models. (Bottom) Each model exposes and enables sweeping across the sensor’s physical parameters (e.g., thermal time constant, correlation function, event thresholds), thereby reproducing modality-specific failure modes.
blocks.zh: 图1:多式联运、高可靠性和可控传感器模拟。 机器人模拟管经常以场景内容为主,俯瞰物理准确的传感器模型. VisionSIM旨在通过模仿不同的传感器类型及其故障模式来弥补这一差距. (Top)单一场景一次被渲染出密集的地真相——色彩,深度,光学流,地表常态,分出分出,点地图,直接和间接发光,以及温度图. (中间) 同一场景再通过广度的传感器模型来回放. (Bottom)每个模型都暴露并能够横扫传感器的物理参数(例如热时常数,关联函数,事件阈值),从而再现出特定模式的故障模式.

blocks.en: We demonstrate VisionSIM by constructing a digital twin of a real single-photon LiDAR, recovering some of its key parameters directly from captured data. This reduces the mean sim-to-real depth error and reproduces two failure modes not previously simulated at this fidelity: pileup-induced range walk, and point-cloud ghosting from retroreflective glare. We further show how VisionSIM can be used to augment existing datasets and to evaluate competing sensor suites (Sec. 5 ). These case studies focus on open-loop sensor fidelity; closed-loop validation is discussed in Section 8 . Finally, we release an indoor dataset featuring synchronized raw outputs of all supported sensors and ground truth annotations (Table 3 ). To our knowledge, it is among the most comprehensive multi-modal datasets of its kind, supporting both training and benchmarking of sensor-fusion algorithms.
blocks.zh: 我们通过构建一个真实的单相光LiDAR的数字双相来演示VisionSIM,直接从所捕获的数据中恢复其一些关键参数. 这减少了平均sim-to-real深度误差,并复制了之前在这个忠贞度上没有模拟过的两种失败模式:堆积所引发的射程行走,和从反射出光芒的点-云鬼. 我们进一步说明如何利用VisionSIM来扩充现有的数据集并评价相互竞争的传感器套件(第5节)。 这些案例研究侧重于开闭式传感器的忠诚性;第8节讨论了闭闭式验证。 最后,我们发布了一个室内数据集,其中包含所有辅助传感器的同步原始输出和地面真实性说明(表3)。 据我们所知,它是此类最全面的多模式数据集之一,支持传感器聚变算法的培训和基准化。

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Task Specific Datasets & Pipelines: There exist several publicly available real and synthetic datasets supporting various computer vision tasks. These are often specific to applications, such as autonomous driving [ 10 , 26 , 87 , 25 ] , or tasks, such as optical flow or stereo matching [ 9 , 56 , 79 , 55 ] . They often lack the metadata, ground truth, and raw sensor access needed for use beyond their original task. The ones with rich annotations are either subsets of larger datasets [ 26 , 87 ] , or are synthetically generated using purpose-built engines such as CARLA [ 20 ] , which are not easily generalizable to other tasks and may lack unconventional modalities such as single-photon or thermal sensors.
blocks.zh: 任务特定数据集和管道 : 有几个公开提供的真实和合成数据集支持各种计算机视觉任务。 这些往往针对应用,如自主驾驶[10,26,87,25],或任务,如光学流或立体匹配[9,56,79,55]. 它们往往缺乏超出其原定任务范围的元数据、地面真象和原始传感器使用权。 内容丰富的说明要么是较大数据集的子集[26,87],要么是使用CARLA[20]等专门制造的发动机合成而成的,这些发动机不易被其他任务所概括,可能缺乏单相或热传感器等非常规模式.

blocks.en: General Purpose Simulation Engines: Many engines (Isaac Gym, Genesis, PhysX, Kubric, Bullet) [ 54 , 3 , 66 , 28 , 16 ] prioritize fast and accurate physics for robotics learning, often at the cost of rendering fidelity. Frameworks such as BlendProc [ 18 ] and Kubric [ 28 ] yield photorealistic results, yet perform no sensor emulation. Others, such as ESIM [ 71 ] , target a single sensor type. VisionSIM addresses both aspects — sensor breadth with physical realism — within a unified pipeline.
blocks.zh: 通用模拟发动机:许多发动机(Isaac Gym,创世纪,PhysX,Kubric,Bullet)[54,3,66,28,16]优先为机器人学习提供快而准确的物理,往往以渲染忠诚为代价. BlendProc [18] 和 Kubric [28] 等框架产生光现实化的结果,然而没有进行传感器仿真. 其它如ESIM [71],瞄准单一传感器类型. 视觉SIM在一个统一的管道内处理两个方面——传感器宽度与物理现实性.

blocks.en: Sensor Emulation Methods: Emulating different sensor types or characteristics from existing real data is an active research direction, lowering the barrier to adopting non-standard sensors. v2e [ 35 ] converts videos to event streams; physics-based infrared generators such as DIRSIG [ 81 ] and MuSES [ 96 ] couple heat solvers to rendering, but are proprietary or domain-specific. VisionSIM combines these trends by bringing single-photon [ 7 , 53 , 41 ] , transient, and light-driven thermal [ 70 , 89 ] sensing into a unified, multi-modal simulation framework for embodied perception.
blocks.zh: 传感器模拟 方法: 从现有真实数据中模拟不同的传感器类型或特征是一个积极的研究方向,降低了采用非标准传感器的障碍. v2e [35] 将视频转换为事件流;基于物理的红外发生器如 DIRSIG [81]和MuSES [96] 夫妇热解器进行渲染,但具有专有性或域特有性. VisionSIM结合了这些趋势,将单发光[7,53,41],瞬态和光驱动热能[70,89]感能带入一个统一的多模式模拟框架,用于体现感能.

blocks.en: 3 Architecture Overview
blocks.zh: 3 结构概览

blocks.en: VisionSIM’s key design choice is to decouple photorealistic rendering from sensor emulation. We first render the clean scene, and then apply physical non-idealities to produce raw measurements. Because these layers are separate, one rendered sequence can be replayed through any sensor model, and parameters can be tweaked at zero extra rendering cost, enabling rapid device calibration.
blocks.zh: VisionSIM的关键设计选择是将光现实性渲染与传感器模拟脱钩. 我们首先制造干净的场景,然后应用物理的非理想性来产生原始的测量. 由于这些地层是相分离的,一个被制成的序列可以通过任何传感器模型来重放,参数可以以零额外渲染成本来被去微调出,从而能够进行快速的设备校正.

blocks.en: World Simulation Layer. This layer is the image-formation engine, producing photorealistic reference frames together with dense ground-truth annotations (depth, normals, optical flow, segmentation, point maps, illumination, poses, and intrinsics) from a Blender scene. It additionally generates ground-truth temperature fields through an integrated, GPU-accelerated heat-transport solver that drives the thermal sensor model (Appendix S.5.4 ). A central challenge is producing frames at the extreme rates demanded by high-speed and asynchronous sensors — event and single-photon cameras operate at tens to hundreds of thousands of frames per second — which is prohibitively expensive to render. VisionSIM addresses this with distributed client/server rendering across heterogeneous hardware, a keyframe-remapping technique that temporally dilates animation splines so complex physics can be sampled at arbitrary frame rates, and a render-then-interpolate strategy that renders ground-truth frames only at each scene’s intrinsic native frame rate and synthesizes the rest with deep video interpolation (e.g., RIFE [ 36 ] ). Together, these yield order-of-magnitude reductions in wall-clock time while preserving high fidelity to fully rendered sequences (Appendix S.2 - S.2.7 ).
blocks.zh: 世界模拟地层. 这个地层是图像-造型引擎,从Blender场景中产生光现实化的参考框架以及密集的地真说明(深度、常态、光学流动、分片、点图、发光、姿势和内在)。 它通过一个能驱动热感应模型的GPU加速热通解器(Appendix S.5.4 ),额外生成地真温场. 一个中心挑战是以高速和同步传感器要求的极快速度生产帧——事件和单相机每秒运行上万到几十万帧——这造价太高了。 VisionSIM通过分布式客户端/服务器跨多相异硬件渲染来解决这个问题,一种按键帧再映射技术,在时间上将动画分解出如此复杂的物理样条可以任意帧速率进行采样,以及一种渲染时的内插策略,它使得地真相帧只能按照每个场景的内在内在帧速率进行并用深层视频插图来合成其余部分(例如RIFE [36]). 再加上这些产量,在一站一站的时间内降低幅度,同时保持高度的忠诚度,使序列完全成型(附录S.2-S.2.7)。

blocks.en: Sensor Emulation Layer. This layer ingests the noise-free, high-frame-rate data and transforms them into realistic sensor measurements. Rather than applying generic additive Gaussian noise to idealized outputs, it implements physically constrained, per-modality measurement models from which noise, distortions, and failure modes naturally emerge as physical consequences. The layer supports conventional and high-speed cameras, stereo and multi-camera rigs, passive single-photon cameras, single-photon (dToF) LiDAR, indirect time-of-flight (iToF) LiDAR, event cameras, thermal cameras, and inertial measurement units. Since it operates on shared reference frames, any subset can be co-simulated on identical scenes and trajectories. The resulting multi-modal measurements are saved in a compressed, sensor-aware format compatible with downstream learning frameworks [ 90 , 8 ] ; stochastic binary single-photon frames, in particular, are stored in a bit-packed manner that achieves 8 × 8\times lossless compression with on-the-fly random access (Appendix S.4 ).
blocks.zh: 感应模拟层. 这层吸收了无噪声的高帧率数据,并将其转化为现实的传感器测量. 它不是将通用添加剂高斯噪音用于理想化的输出,而是采用物理受限、通式测量模型,从这些模型中,噪音、扭曲和故障模式自然成为物理后果。 该地层支持常规相机和高速相机,立体相机和多相机相机,被动单相机,单相机(dTOF)LiDAR,间接飞行时间(iTOF)LiDAR,事件相机,热相机,和惯性测量单元. 由于它运行在共享的参考框架上,任何子集都可以在同一场景和轨迹上被同化. 由此产生的多模式测量被以与下游学习框架相兼容的压缩,感应-意识格式保存 [90, 8];特别是有花样的二进制单相光框被以比特包的方式存储,通过飞行上随机访问实现8×8\时间的无损失压缩(Appendix S.4.

blocks.en: 4 Physically-Grounded Sensor Models and Failure Modes
blocks.zh: 4 物理组合传感器模型和失败模式

blocks.en: We now detail the physically accurate sensor models for three representative modalities whose failure modes are least faithfully captured by existing simulators: single-photon LiDAR, indirect time-of-flight LiDAR, and thermal cameras. Forward models and implementation details for all supported sensors are in Appendix S.3 ; Table 2 summarizes their failure modes and parameters.
blocks.zh: 我们现在详细介绍三种具有代表性的模式的物理精确感应模型,这些模式的故障模式被现有的模拟器最不忠实地抓住:单发光LiDAR,间接飞行时间LiDAR和热相机. 所有辅助传感器的前进模型和执行细节载于附录S.3;表2概述了其故障模式和参数。

blocks.en: Table 2: Failure modes and parameters modeled by VisionSIM. For each supported modality, we list the non-idealities and failure modes VisionSIM reproduces and the principal user-controllable parameters. Full forward models for all modalities are given in Appendix S.3 .

blocks.en: In high-flux conditions, modeling dead time (time interval after a photon detection when the sensor is inhibited) emulates pileup-distorted measurements [ 13 , 68 ] : later-arriving photons are systematically lost, resulting in histograms biased toward earlier bins and shallower depth estimates ( range walk error ) and poor SNR, particularly for distant objects (Fig. 1 ). Intra-histogram motion blur can cause erroneous depth estimates, causing safety-critical issues (Fig. 4 ). Conventional simulators that model LiDARs as noiseless range-finders would fail to capture these effects.
blocks.zh: 在高通量条件下,模拟死活时间(在传感器被抑制时被光子检测后的时间间隔)模仿了堆积扭曲的测量 [13,68] :后到的光子被系统丢失,导致直方图偏向于更早的被子和更浅的深度估计(射程行走出错)和差的SNR,特别是远地物体(图1). 相距内运动模糊可能导致错误的深度估计,引起安全临界问题(图4. 将LiDARs作为无噪声射程探测器的常规模拟器将无法捕捉到这些效果。

blocks.en: 4.3 Thermal Cameras
blocks.zh: 4.3 热相机

blocks.en: Long-wave infrared (LWIR) thermal cameras differ from other modalities in that they not only measure reflected thermal light due to light transport but also capture light emitted by an object due to the underlying heat transport process happening within and around the object. The radiance at each pixel is the integrated long-wave emission of the surface in front of it, governed by Planck’s law and weighted by the surface’s emissivity, with an additive reflected-ambient term.
blocks.zh: 长波红外相机与其他方式不同,因为它们不仅测量由于光传输而反射出热光,而且还捕获物体在物体内部和周围发生的潜在的热传输过程所发射出光。 每个像素的光度是表面在其前方的集成长波放出,受普朗克定律所支配并被表面的放出度所加权,并带有添加剂反射-环境学术语.

blocks.en: Crucially, this signal depends not on instantaneous lighting but on the temperature field that geometry, materials, and the scene’s recent history (minutes to hours of prior illumination, contact, and conduction) have produced — a quantity conventional graphics pipelines do not compute. Existing thermal-simulation tools [ 82 ] sidestep this by painting a static “temperature texture” onto each surface or assuming radiative equilibrium with a single user-provided heat source [ 78 ] ; neither approach reproduces the material- and history-dependent thermal contrast that defines real LWIR imagery, such as differential cooling across materials (ceramic vs. metal mugs cooling at different rates in Fig. 3 ), residual heat from recent contact, or radiator-like sources that linger after shutoff. VisionSIM directly integrates a fast physics-based heat solver in its world simulation layer, so thermal imagery can be produced alongside the other modalities. For details on our light-to-heat simulation, thermal rendering, and microbolometer inertia, see Appendix S.5.4 .
blocks.zh: 关键是,这个信号不取决于瞬间发光,而取决于几何,材料,以及现场近代历史(从先前发光,接触和传导的分数到小时)所产生的温度场——一个数量级的常规图形管道不计算出. 现有的热模拟工具[82]通过将静态“温度纹理”涂入每个地表或以单一用户提供的热源假设出辐射平衡[78]来绕开这一点;这两种方法都无法复制界定真实的LWIR图像的依赖材料和历史的热对比,例如材料之间的分量冷却(图3中对金属杯的冷却率不同)、最近接触产生的残留热量,或关闭后遗留的类似辐射源等。 VisionSIM在其世界模拟地层中直接融合了以物理学为基础的快热解析器,因此可以与其他模式一起生成热成像. 关于我们从轻到热模拟、热渲染和微波计惯性的细节,见附录S.5.4。

blocks.en: 5 Case Studies: Design and Analysis of Robot Perception Systems
blocks.zh: 5个案例研究:机器人感知系统的设计和分析

blocks.en: Next, we illustrate potential applications of VisionSIM, each with a case study (Figure 4 ) designed to serve as a proof-of-concept via a representative example. All studies are open-loop, focusing on sensor fidelity rather than closed-loop control (Section 8 ).
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们举例说明了VisionSIM的潜在应用,每个应用都有一个案例研究(图4),目的是通过一个具有代表性的例子证明概念。 所有研究都是开放式的,侧重于传感器的忠诚性,而不是闭路控制(第8节)。

blocks.en: Building digital twins of real sensors. VisionSIM enables building perceptual digital twins: a model whose parameters are calibrated so that its simulated raw measurements match those of a specific physical device, capturing the sensor’s characteristic noise and failure modes. This is critical for closing the sim-to-real gap on the target deployment hardware.
blocks.zh: 打造数字双胞胎真能感应器. VisionSIM能够建立能感知到的数码双胞胎:一个其参数经过校正的模型,使其模拟的原始测量结果与特定物理设备的测量结果相匹配,捕捉到传感器的特征噪声和故障模式. 这对于缩小目标部署硬件的正对正差距至关重要。

blocks.en: We build a digital twin of a commercial single-photon LiDAR (Adaps Photonics ADS6311 [ 1 ] ; details in Appendix S.6 ). Because VisionSIM’s dToF model is differentiable, we recover the device’s parameters directly from real captures via gradient-based fitting of a measurement-matching loss, which we demonstrate with the sensor’s impulse response function (IRF). We validate the twin on a scene captured in the lab and modeled in Blender (Figure 4 , top), chosen because it exercises two failure modes at once. The retroreflective sign produces an intense return that saturates the detector; the recovered IRF and dead time reproduce the resulting pileup and range-walk error. That same intense return induces glare through internal multipath between the sensor optics and the detector array, which the spatially-varying PSF captures, reproducing the characteristic point-cloud ghosting. The resulting reconstructed depth closely tracks the device’s measured depth. Faithfully modeling the IRF, pileup, and glare lowers the RMSE of the digital twin by ∼ 1.53 {\raise 0.73193pt\hbox{$\scriptstyle\sim$}}1.53 meters.
blocks.zh: 我们建造了商用单相光相机(Adaps Photonics ADS6311 [1];详见附录S.6)。 因为VisionSIM的dToF模型是不同的,所以我们直接通过基于梯度的安装测量-比对损失来从实际捕获中恢复设备的参数,我们用传感器的冲动反应功能(IRF)来证明这一点。 我们在实验室拍摄的一幕中验证了双胞胎,并以Blender(图4,顶部)为模型,之所以选择双胞胎,是因为双胞胎同时锻炼出两种失败模式. 反向反射标志产生出使探测器饱和的强烈回放;被恢复的IRF和已死时间再现所形成的堆积和射程-行走出错. 同样的强烈回放通过传感器光学和探测器阵列之间的内部多路径诱发光泽,空间变化的PSF捕捉到这些光泽,再现出典型的点-云幽. 由此重建的深度密切跟踪设备的测量深度。 忠实地模拟IRF,堆放,并用闪光来降低数字双胞胎的RMSE 由相差1.53米的相差0.73193pt\hbox{$\scripttyle\sim\sim 1.53米.

blocks.en: Migrating existing datasets to new sensing modalities. The decoupled architecture also enables migrating existing datasets to modalities they were never captured with, by bypassing world simulation and feeding pre-existing data directly to the sensor emulation layer. We show three examples (Figure 4 , middle): emulating a passive single-photon camera from the XVFI high-speed video dataset [ 84 ] ; generating an event stream from a Genesis render of a dancing humanoid [ 3 , 100 ] ; and producing raw single-photon LiDAR transients from a CARLA driving sequence [ 20 ] . Uplifting a conventional autonomous-driving dataset into time-resolved single-photon measurements lets sensor-specific failure modes be exposed: here, the pedestrian might not be detected at the sensor level as their lateral motion induces motion blur within the transient histograms, causing depth errors in excess of 3 3 meters. This lets researchers obtain data for emerging sensors by reusing existing assets, rather than recapturing scenes with specialized and often unavailable hardware. Dataset migration is bounded by what the source data contains: the frame rate caps the temporal resolution of the emulated sensor, and each modality needs its own annotations, so a dataset without depth cannot be uplifted to iToF or dToF.
blocks.zh: 将现有数据集迁移到新的遥感模式。 脱钩的架构还使现有的数据集能够通过绕过世界模拟和将先前存在的数据直接输入传感器仿真层,转移到从未捕捉到的模式上。 我们举出三个例子(图4,中段):从XVFI高速视频数据集复制一款被动单相相机[84];从舞蹈人造物的创世纪渲染出一串事件流[3,100];从CARLA的驱动序列中生成生单相机LiDAR转子[20]. 将传统的自动驱动数据集提升到时间解析的单相光测量中,可以使传感器特有的故障模式被曝光:在这里,行人可能不会在传感器一级被检测出,因为他们的平面运动会诱发瞬间直方图内的运动模糊,导致深度误差超过3 3米. 这使得研究人员能够通过重新使用现有资产,而不是用专门和往往没有的硬件来取回场景来获取新兴传感器的数据. 数据集迁移被源数据包含的内容所约束:帧速率封顶了被模拟的传感器的时间分辨率,每个模式都需要自己的说明,因此一个没有深度的数据集不能被提升到iToF或dToF.

blocks.en: Evaluating & benchmarking sensor suites. Sensor emulation decoupling enables a single rendered scene to be replayed through many sensor configurations at no additional rendering cost, allowing comparisons of candidate suites before any hardware is built. We demonstrate this through a robot perception case study, where a system architect selects between two sensor suites for low-light, dynamic environments: a conventional camera paired with an event camera, or a passive single-photon camera and IMU. Both are emulated on identical high-speed trajectories; each suite’s raw measurements are reconstructed into image-like representations using existing methods [ 88 , 53 ] , and passed to an off-the-shelf detection and tracking model [ 73 ] to compare downstream task performance (Figure 4 , bottom). Detection fails in the first case, while the second sensor suite yields 90 % 90\% confidence. Both reconstruction models and the detector are used zero-shot, so the result characterizes the full pipeline rather than the sensor suite alone; retraining on raw measurements would remove the reconstruction bias. Sweeping sensor parameters (exposure, event threshold, fill factor, etc.) within the same framework lets the architect map the trade-off across operating regimes, a comparison that is prohibitively expensive to perform with real hardware.
blocks.zh: 评估与基准传感器套房。 传感器仿真脱钩使得一个被制成的单一场景能够通过许多传感器配置被重放而无需额外的渲染成本,从而可以在任何硬件建成之前对候选套房进行比较. 我们通过机器人感知案例研究来证明这一点,一个系统建筑师在两个传感器套间中选择低光能,动态环境:一个常规相机与事件相机对接,或者一个被动的单相机和IMU. 两者在相同的高速轨迹上被效仿;每个套房的原始测量被重建成采用现有方法[88,53]的像图像的表示,并传递到现成的检测和跟踪模型[73]来比较下游的任务性能(图4,底部). 第一种情况检测失败,而第二种传感器套件产生90%的90-%的信心。 重建模型和探测器均被用到"零发",因此结果的特征是全管而不是光是感应套件;对原始测量的再培训会消除重建偏差. 在同一框架内扫描传感器参数(曝光、事件阈值、填充系数等),使建筑师能够绘制跨操作系统的取舍图,这种比较与真正的硬件相比,费用高昂。

blocks.zh: 6 Sim-to-Real 验证

blocks.en: In the previous section, we calibrated a dToF sensor twin using a handful of real measurements. Here, in Fig. 5 , we further compare real and simulated sensor measurements for four additional modalities. The first two rows show sensor measurements simulated end-to-end using a digital twin of a real scene, and compared against captures of the same physical scene. The latter two emulate the simulated measurements using real conventional video, also validating our emulation protocol.
blocks.zh: 在上一节中,我们用一些真实的测量来校正一个dToF传感器双子. 在这里,图5中,我们进一步比较了真实和模拟的传感器测量,用于另外四种模式。 前两行显示传感器测量使用真实场景的数码双相来模拟端到端,并比较了同一物理场景的捕获. 后两者利用真正的常规录像模拟测量,也验证我们的模拟协议。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Simulation Fidelity. Comparison of simulated vs. captured scenes. The top two rows are simulated end-to-end using a digital twin of the real scene, while the bottom two emulate the corresponding sensors from a co-located conventional camera capture (inset).
blocks.zh: 图5:模拟菲德尔. 模拟场景与被俘场景的比较. 上两行是使用真实场景的数字双相来模拟端到端的,而下两行则从同位相机常规相机捕获(inset)来模拟相应的传感器.

blocks.en: For a mug filling with hot tea, the simulated heating profile tracks a real-world capture from a FLIR Boson to within a mean absolute error of 7.6 % 7.6\% of the real mug’s heating dynamic range over the 4 seconds following the fill. Against a real capture of a STOP sign taken with a Chronoptics iToF camera, our emulated iToF sensor achieves a mean phase error of 0.13 0.13 radians across a [ 0 , 2 ​ π ] [0,2\pi] range. At a 40 MHz modulation frequency, this translates to a mean depth error of about 5.3 5.3 cm. Event counts emulated on RGB video of an auditorium differ from a real recording taken with a Prophesee EVK4 sensor by 1.5 % 1.5\% for positive events and 5.8 % 5.8\% for negative events. The photon detection statistics of our emulated Pi-Imaging SPAD sensor, likewise driven by RGB video, reach 0.221 0.221 against a measured 0.229 0.229 .
blocks.zh: 模拟取暖图象从FLIR Boson记录真实世界的取暖情况, 面对用Chronoptics iToF相机拍摄的STOP标志的真实捕捉,我们所模拟的iToF传感器在[0,2] [0,2\pi]射程上实现了0.13 0.13弧度的平相误差. 在40MHz调制频率上,这表示平均深度误差约为5.3 5.3厘米. 与用预言EVK4传感器拍摄的真实录音不同, 积极事件为1.5%, 我们仿制的 Pi-Imaging SPAD 传感器的光子探测统计数据同样由 RGB 视频驱动, 与测量到的 0. 229 0. 229 相比达到 0.221 0.221 。

blocks.en: Small discrepancies remain in each case. The thermal error follows the emitters’ surface emissivity and the way our heat-transport solver couples the mug to its surroundings: since the mug exchanges heat with a room whose ambient temperature we do not measure, a small error in either term propagates into the simulated surface temperature. For iToF, some of the discrepancy comes from the sensor’s departure from the ideal. We assume a sinusoidal coding scheme, so the correlation model misses the multipath and higher-harmonic distortion that the physical Chronoptics device introduces. For the two modalities emulated from RGB video, discrepancies can arise before the sensor model runs. Our event-camera model matches the expected spread of contrast thresholds, but its front-end bandwidth and refractory period use the generic DVS model rather than the EVK4, potentially affecting event counts. The Pi-Imaging emulation faces a tougher challenge: mapping linearly rectified intensities to photon detection statistics requires knowing the source camera’s unknown white balance and uncalibrated photometric response. As a result, the single-photon outcome is limited by the source camera, not our sensor model—an error that does not affect the digital-twin rows of Fig. 5 , which are simulated end-to-end.
blocks.zh: 每一种情况都存在小的差异。 热量误差跟随发射者的表面传播, 以及我们的热能解析器将相伴相伴相伴, 对于iToF来说,有些差异来自于传感器偏离了理想. 我们假设一个线粒体编码方案, 所以相关模型 忽略了多路径和更高谐调的扭曲 物理克罗诺普斯设备引入。 对于从RGB视频中模仿的两种模式,在传感器模型运行前可能会出现差异. 我们的事件-相机模型与预期的对比阈值相匹配,但其前端带宽和折射期使用通用的DVS模型而不是EVK4,可能影响到事件计数. Pi-Imaging仿真面临更严峻的挑战:将线性修正的强度映射到光子检测统计数据需要了解源相机未知的白色平衡和未校正的光度测量反应. 因此,单相相机的结果受到源相机的限制,而不是我们的传感器模型——这个错误不会影响图5的数码双相行,它们是模拟的端到端.

blocks.en: 7 The VisionSIM Multi-Modal Sensor Dataset
blocks.zh: 7 远景规划 多分解传感器数据集

blocks.en: A key capability of VisionSIM is multi-modal dataset generation : a user selects scenes, camera trajectories, resolution and frame rate, the sensors to emulate, and their physical parameters, and the platform produces synchronized multi-sensor measurements with dense ground truth for a given set of tasks. To demonstrate this capability, we generate and release one such dataset, described below.
blocks.zh: VisionSIM的关键能力是多模式数据集生成:用户选择场景,相机轨迹,分辨率和帧率,模拟感应器,以及它们的物理参数,平台为特定一组任务产生同步多传感器测量,并有密集地地面真实性. 为了证明这种能力,我们生成并发布一个这样的数据集,如下所述。

blocks.en: An indoor instantiation. We curate 100 100 unique indoor scenes spanning offices, kitchens, bathrooms, etc., each with a predefined 24 24 -second camera trajectory. Each scene is rendered at 100 100 fps in HDR at 1000 × 1000 1000\times 1000 as a stereo pair, with ground-truth poses, intrinsics, depth, surface normals, optical and scene flow, segmentation, temperature, and direct/indirect illumination components, yielding 480,000 480{,}000 synchronized ground-truth views. From these, we emulate the full sensor suite: a single-photon camera at 16 16 kHz (via 160 × 160\times interpolation), a 4 4 kHz event camera ( 40 × 40\times ), a 25 25 fps conventional camera, dToF and iToF LiDAR, a thermal sensor, an IMU at 250 250 Hz, and a stereo rig, using representative noise parameters drawn from the literature [ 21 , 65 , 51 , 35 , 29 , 6 , 49 , 56 , 31 , 32 , 37 ] .
blocks.zh: 室内即兴表演 我们管理100个独特的室内场景, 横跨办公室、厨房、浴室等等, 每一个场景都有预先定义的24 24秒相机轨迹。 每个场景在"HDR"中以100平方英尺(1000×1000×1000\times 1000)作为立体对映,具有地真姿势,内在,深度,地表常态,光学和场景流动,分出分出,温度,以及直接/间接发光组件,产生48万480{,}000同步地真视. 从这些镜头中,我们模拟了全传感器套装:一台16千赫的单相机(通过160×160相机插座),一台4千赫事件相机(40×40相机),一台25平方英尺的常规相机,dToF和iToF LiDAR,一台热传感器,一台250赫兹的IMU,以及一台立体钻机,使用从文献中抽取的代表性噪声参数[21,65,51,35,29,6,49,56,31,32,37].

blocks.en: Simulating these streams guarantees perfect spatial co-registration and temporal synchronization—conditions that are exceedingly difficult to meet on a physical rig. Moreover, specialized hardware like high-resolution SPADs remains rare and expensive. As Table 3 shows, our dataset provides broader modality and annotation coverage than prior datasets, with raw sensor data (e.g., transient histograms) rather than just processed outputs.
blocks.zh: 模拟这些流保证了完美的空间共同登记和时间同步——在物理钻机上极其难以满足的条件。 此外,诸如高分辨的SPAD等专门硬件仍然很罕见和昂贵. 如表3所示,我们的数据集比以前的数据集提供了更广泛的模式和注释覆盖范围,有原始的传感器数据(如瞬态直方图),而不是仅仅经过处理的产出.

blocks.en: Table 3: Landscape of computer vision datasets. Existing datasets focus primarily on specific modalities (e.g., event cameras or LiDAR) or lack advanced sensor emulation (e.g., SPADs or thermal), VisionSIM provides a comprehensive suite of multi-modal data including HDR stereo views, optical flow, point maps, and a wide variety of physically-based sensor emulations in a single unified dataset.
blocks.zh: 表3:计算机视觉数据集景观. 现有数据集主要侧重于特定模式(如事件相机或LiDAR)或缺乏高级传感器仿真(如SPAD或热能),VisionSIM提供了一套全面的多模式数据,包括HDR立体视图,光学流,点图,以及各种物理传感器仿真在一个单一的统一数据集.

blocks.en: Release. We release the ground-truth components together with the scripts, assets, and checksums needed to regenerate the full sensor data (due to the large data size). The same scripts that regenerate our dataset let a user reconfigure it — changing resolution, frame rate, the set of emulated sensors, or their parameters — to produce a dataset tailored to their application. Implementation details of the generation interface are given in Appendix S.7 .
blocks.zh: 释出. 我们释放地面真实组件以及脚本,资产,以及重新生成完整传感器数据所需的校验和(因为数据大了). 重新生成我们的数据集的同一批脚本让一个用户重新配置它——改变分辨率,帧率,仿真传感器的一组,或者他们的参数——来制作一个适合其应用的数据集. 生成界面的实施细节见附录S.7.

blocks.en: 8 Limitations and Outlook
blocks.zh: 8 限制和前景

blocks.en: VisionSIM aims to model the raw measurement formation of a broad range of conventional and emerging modalities, together with their characteristic noise and failure modes. The goal is to narrow the gap between idealized synthetic data and real sensor measurements, and support sensor-aware design and analysis that idealized simulators cannot.
blocks.zh: VisionSIM旨在模拟各种常规和新兴模式的原始计量形成,以及这些模式的特征噪音和故障模式。 目标是缩小理想化合成数据与真实感应测量之间的差距,支持理想化模拟器所不能的感应-意识设计与分析.

blocks.en: Scope of the current results. The digital twin case-study is demonstrated on a single commercial device and a small set of scenes; broader validation across devices, scenes, and operating conditions remains future work. The sensor-suite study is a preliminary, single-task case study (object detection under a CMOS-plus-event versus SPAD-plus-IMU comparison) rather than a comprehensive design analysis. All current evaluations are open-loop: we do not yet close the perception–control loop on a physical or simulated robot. Finally, the released dataset is indoor-only; adding outdoor scenes across various operating regimes is an important next step.
blocks.zh: 目前结果的范围。 数字双子案例研究在单一的商业装置和一套小场景上展示;更广泛的跨设备、场景和操作条件验证仍然是未来的工作。 传感器成套研究是一个初步的单一任务案例研究(根据CMOS-plus-event对SPAD-plus-IMU的比较进行对象检测),而不是全面的设计分析. 目前所有的评价都是开放的:我们还没有关闭物理或模拟机器人上的感知-控制循环。 最后,所发布的数据集是室内专用的;在各种操作系统之间增加户外场景是下一步的一个重要步骤.

blocks.en: Architectural limitations. Decoupling world simulation from sensor emulation requires an intermediate abstraction (e.g., depth and albedo for dToF). This enables efficient emulation of sensor-level effects such as pileup, dead time, and jitter, and provides a favorable compromise between speed, modularity, and physical accuracy. However, it precludes direct emulation of volumetric effects and higher-order light transport, as required for modeling complex weather phenomena. Because world simulation is ray-tracing-based, wave-propagation effects such as diffraction are also difficult to capture [ 45 ] , complicating extension to modalities such as mmWave radar.
blocks.zh: 建筑限制. 将世界模拟从传感器模拟中脱钩需要中间抽象(如dToF的深度和反照率). 这样可以有效地模拟传感器层面的效果,如堆积、枯燥和焦燥,并在速度、模块性和物理准确性之间作出有利的妥协。 然而,它排除了直接模拟体积效应和高序光传输,这是模拟复杂天气现象所需的. 因为世界模拟是以射线跟踪为基础的,分流等波向传播效应也难以捕捉到[45],使扩展到mmWave雷达等模式变得复杂.

blocks.en: Outlook. A future direction is to integrate VisionSIM with real-time engines such as Unreal Engine [ 22 ] , which could reduce rendering cost and broaden material and asset variety, while moving toward closed-loop and eventually real-time simulation. Incorporating wave-based propagation would open the door to radar and other diffraction-limited sensors, and a library of calibrated sensor presets would let widely-deployed devices be emulated out of the box. We see VisionSIM as a step toward making sensor selection and perception-system design an evidence-based discipline, and we release the platform, assets, and generation scripts toward that goal.
blocks.zh: 展望。 未来的方向是将VisionSIM与"不真实引擎"等实时引擎相融合,这可以降低渲染成本并拓宽材料和资产种类,同时向闭路并最终实现实时模拟. 采用以波为主的传播方式将打开雷达和其他有扩散限制的传感器的大门,一个校正传感器预设库将使广泛部署的装置能被从盒子中仿出。 我们认为,VisionSIM是使感官选择和感知系统设计成为基于证据的学科的一个步骤,我们向这个目标释放了平台、资产和生成脚本。

blocks.en: S.1 Architecture
blocks.zh: S.1 建筑

blocks.en: VisionSIM is designed from the ground up to be maximally flexible. A key design principle is its multi-layered architecture that enables it to simulate a variety of seemingly unrelated sensor modalities (including unconventional and emerging sensors such as single-photon cameras which excel in high-speed and high dynamic range environments [ 53 , 52 ] ) with minimal effort by reusing its different components and extending them with plug-ins if needed.
blocks.zh: 愿景SIM的设计从地上向上,最灵活。 一个关键的设计原则是它的多层结构,它能够模拟各种看似无关的传感器模式(包括在高速和高动态射程环境中表现优异的非常规和新兴的相机等单相机[53,52]),通过重新使用其不同部件并在需要时用插件来尽量不费力.

blocks.en: The simulation engine is made up of layers that are accessible both (a) as a command-line interface tool, which is useful to complete common operations such as rendering different types of ground truth data or emulating conventional cameras, and (b) as a full-fledged library, which enables more complicated workflows such as simulating multi-camera rigs. These layers are as follows:
blocks.zh: 模拟引擎由可访问的地层组成,既可以(a)作为命令行接口工具,对于完成诸如提供不同类型的地真数据或仿照常规相机等共同操作很有用;也可以(b)作为完整的库可以使模拟多相机钻机等更复杂的工作流程. 这些层如下:

blocks.en: World Simulation Layer: Generate rich ground truth data annotations using high-quality rendering engines, optionally interpolate to higher frame rates to emulate realistic motion blur and high-speed sensors.
blocks.zh: 世界模拟地层:利用高品质渲染引擎生成丰富的地面真伪数据说明,可选地插入更高的帧率来模拟现实运动模糊和高速传感器.

blocks.en: Sensor Emulation Layer: Emulate different sensor modalities using realistic image-formation models, enabling physically accurate sensor noise.
blocks.zh: 传感器模拟层:利用现实的图像-造型模型来模拟不同的传感器模式,使物理上准确的传感器噪音成为可能.

blocks.en: Once simulated, new datasets are stored with all relevant metadata in a way that enables easy iteration and random access, enabling easy interoperability with existing frameworks.
blocks.zh: 新的数据集一旦被模拟,就与所有相关元数据一起存储,以便便于迭代和随机访问,便于与现有框架互操作。

blocks.en: While the default workflow is to use these layers in sequence to manipulate the data until it is in the desired format, these can be used individually and even out of order to support different applications. For instance, if we skip the simulation layer and instead provide real high-speed video captures ( e.g. from XVFI [ 84 ] ), we can emulate high-speed sensing modalities ( e.g. event cameras and single-photon cameras), or conventional cameras from this dataset using the sensor emulation layer.
blocks.zh: 虽然默认的工作流程是按顺序使用这些层来操纵数据直到它达到所期望的格式,但是这些可以单独使用,甚至出于支持不同应用程序的需要. 例如,如果我们跳过模拟层,而是提供真实的高速视频捕捉(例如来自XVFI [84]),我们可以模仿高速感测模式(例如事件相机和单相机),或者使用传感器模拟层从这个数据集取出常规相机.

blocks.en: S.2 World simulation
blocks.zh: S.2 世界模拟

blocks.en: The first step is to render out clean, blur and noise-free RGB images, depth maps, as well as normal maps, and other data modalities where applicable, which will both enable the emulation of different sensor types as well as act as ground truth.
blocks.zh: 第一步是制作干净、模糊和无噪声的RGB图像、深度地图以及普通地图,并酌情制作其他数据模式,既能模拟不同的传感器类型,又能作为地面真相。

blocks.en: While there are many high-quality rendering engines such as Unreal Engine [ 22 ] or Mitsuba3 [ 42 ] , we opt to use Blender [ 14 ] as our primary rendering engine as it is easy to integrate with, widely accessible, well supported and produces photorealistic images.
blocks.zh: 虽然有许多高质量的渲染引擎,如"不真实引擎"[22]或"Mitsuba3"[42]等,但我们选择使用"Blender"[14]作为我们的主要渲染引擎,因为它容易与相接,广泛可及,支持良好并产生光现实化的图像.

blocks.en: However, Blender’s built-in API is very complex and not tailored towards high frame-rate rendering. It has a built-in maximum frame rate – which is not sufficient to model event cameras or single-photon cameras natively, the latter of which can operate at hundreds of thousands of frames per second – and has no easy way to output some ground truth annotations such as camera intrinsics.
blocks.zh: 然而,Blender的内置API非常复杂,不适应高帧率渲染. 它有一个内置的最大帧率——这不足以在本土模拟事件相机或单相相机,后者可以以每秒几十万帧的速度运行——并且没有简单的方法输出一些地面真实说明,如相机所固有的.

blocks.en: Further, rendering can be very costly and this cost scales with frame rate. By default, when a frame is rendered system utilization can be near a hundred percent, yet in between frames, or when setting up the scene for the next render, utilization is nearly zero, leading to spiky system load and underutilized resources further compounding slow render times. Finally, authoring new assets that target high fps is difficult as graphic designers are not used to doing so, and most existing assets would either playback at unrealistic speeds or be completely broken if they relied on more complicated effects such as geometry nodes or custom shaders.
blocks.zh: 此外,渲染成本可能很高,而这种成本尺度按帧率计算。 默认情况下,当一个帧制成的系统利用率可以接近100%,但介于帧之间,或者当为下一次渲染设置场景时,利用率几乎为零,导致系统负荷飞涨,资源利用不足,进一步增加缓慢渲染时间。 最后,由于图形设计师不习惯以高频fps为目标的新资产编写工作很困难,大多数现有资产要么以不切实际的速度回放,要么如果依赖于几何节点或自定义的阴影等更复杂的效果,就会被完全打破.

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we introduce a streamlined rendering API that simplifies the dataset generation workflow, makes it easy to reuse or create assets that have been authored for slower conventional frame rates, and allows for fast, distributed rendering on heterogeneous hardware.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了一个简化的渲染API,简化了数据集生成工作流程,使其易于再利用或创造出已被作者用于较慢常规帧率的资产,并允许快速地,分批地在多样硬件上进行渲染.

blocks.en: S.2.1 Streamlined API
blocks.zh: S.2.1 简化API

blocks.en: Blender provides an extensive python API, namely bpy , that exposes virtually all of Blender’s functionality. However, it is only accessible through Blender’s internal Python distribution or as a Python module if the user compiles Blender from its source. We instead provide a simplified API which provides a higher-level interface that streamlines the dataset generation process and automatically handles common pitfalls users might encounter.
blocks.zh: Blender提供了广泛的蟒蛇API,即bpy,它几乎暴露了Blender的所有功能. 然而,它只能通过 Blender 的内部 Python 发行或作为 Python 模块访问,如果用户从源头编译出 Blender 。 相反,我们提供了一个简化的API,提供更高级的界面,精简数据集生成过程并自动处理用户可能遇到的常见陷阱.

blocks.en: This simplified API makes no assumptions about the scene that is loaded and will by default attempt to use all render settings the user set within Blender. While a new rendering pass, along with all necessary compositing nodes, might be automatically added to support different ground truth annotations, it is the user’s responsibility to provide functional blend files. In Fig. 1 (C, left), multiple animations are rendered, and a rendering pass to get surface normals is automatically added if needed. However, an animation will not be rendered if its corresponding blender file is malformed in such a way that manually rendering a frame from within Blender does not work. Further, this simplified API makes it easy for users to generate different types of ground truth annotations and change common rendering settings such as targeting a different render device or changing resolution, as well as more advanced operations like manual camera updates within the render loop.
blocks.zh: 此简化的 API 对装入的场景不作假设, 默认会尝试使用 Blender 内的所有配置 。 虽然可以自动添加一个新的渲染传出,加上所有必要的混音节点,以支持不同的地面真实说明,但提供功能混合文件是用户的责任. 在图一(C,左)中,会提供多部动画,如果需要,会自动添加一个渲染传出以获得表面常态. 然而,如果动画对应的搅拌器文件的造型不当,使Blender内部的帧手动渲染不起作用,则动画将不会被渲染出. 此外,这种简化的API使得用户很容易生成不同类型的地真说明并改变常见的渲染设置,如瞄准不同的渲染设备或改变分辨率,以及更先进的操作,如渲染回圈内的手动相机更新.

blocks.en: S.2.2 Distributed rendering
blocks.zh: S.2.2 分布式渲染

blocks.en: To enable scalable simulations, we employ a client/server architecture, shown in Fig. 1 (A), that uses remote procedure calls (RPCs) as the communication medium. A few minimal dependencies are injected within Blender’s runtime, which enables it to run as a server, listening for requests to set up scenes, move around cameras, render data, etc. Specifically, doing so from within Blender’s runtime enables us to access all features through the bpy package and expose them via RPCs.
blocks.zh: 为了能够进行可缩放的模拟,我们采用图1(A)所示的客户端/服务器架构,使用远程程序调用(RPC)作为通信媒介. 在Blender的运行时间里注入了几个最小的依赖性,这使得它能够作为一个服务器运行,倾听请求以建立场景,移动相机,渲染数据等. 在Blender的运行时间里,

blocks.en: Correctly orchestrating many rendering servers is technically challenging. First, to enable easy discovery of servers, a registry server is spawned and listens for UDP-based broadcast messages from rendered servers that are available. This rendezvous server communicates with the main client to inform it about available workers, enabling the user to connect to the server instances and distribute work amongst the worker pool, or even use multiple render servers to render out a single animation. Servers manage their own logging and exception handling, and, in the event of some unexpected crash, we ensure that the dataset is not corrupted and the process resources are freed.
blocks.zh: 正确安排许多渲染服务器在技术上具有挑战性。 首先,为了方便地发现服务器,一个注册服务器被产出,并听取来自已提供服务器的基于UDP的广播信息。 这个会合服务器与主要客户端进行通信,告知其可用的工人,使用户能够连接到服务器实例,并在工人池中分配工作,甚至使用多个渲染服务器来渲染出单一的动画. 服务器管理自己的日志和例外处理,在出现出乎意料的崩溃时,我们保证数据集不会被损坏并释放进程资源.

blocks.en: This client/server architecture can drastically cut down on processing time and enables the use of a distributed set of machines with heterogeneous hardware. Even when worker processes are on the same machine, as is the case when using BlenderClients ’ spawn or pool directives (Fig. 1 (C)), render times can be shorter as the system’s resources will be better utilized. Such distributed capability is a novel contribution to the Blender ecosystem as it provides the tooling for scalable and distributed renders – which many companies, render farms, and add-ons provide as a paid service – as a free and open-source library, which will democratize scaling of simulation-based bootstrapping of ML models.
blocks.zh: 这种客户端/服务器架构可以大幅缩短处理时间并能够使用一套分布式的具有多相分化硬件的机器. 即使在使用Blenderclients的产卵指令(图1(C))时,工人的工艺也在同一台机器上,但随着系统资源得到更好的利用,生产时间也会缩短。 这样的分布式能力是对Blender生态系统的新贡献,因为它为可扩展和分布式生态系统提供了工具 — — 许多公司、农场和附加物作为有偿服务提供了这种工具 — — 作为免费和开放源码的图书馆,它将民主化地推广基于模拟的ML模型。

blocks.en: For even larger-scale dataset generation tasks such as the dataset in Section 7 , we employ a second layer of distributed computing through the use of HTCondor [ 12 ] , a high-throughput computing framework widely deployed in academic and institutional clusters. This involves containerizing our entire simulation stack, including all scripts, dependencies, and assets, using Docker [ 57 ] , which is automated in CI/CD, and submitting jobs to an HTCondor access point. This setup allowed us to leverage thousands of CPU cores and hundreds of GPUs across thousands of machines to render out the VisionSIM dataset described in Sec. 7 .
blocks.zh: 对于更大的数据集生成任务,例如第7节中的数据集,我们通过使用HTCondor[12],使用第二层分布式计算,这是一个在学术和机构集群中广泛部署的高通量计算框架. 这涉及到将我们整个模拟堆栈,包括所有脚本,依赖性,和资产,用CI/CD自动化的多克[57],将任务提交到HTCondor访问点. 这个设置使我们能够利用数千台CPU核心和上百台GPU在上千台机器上的杠杆,来渲染出 Sec. 7所描述的VisionSIM数据集.

blocks.en: S.2.3 Keyframe remapping
blocks.zh: S.2.3 重新绘制关键框架

blocks.en: To address the challenges related to authoring high-speed assets and overcome Blender’s maximum frame rate limitations, we propose to dynamically remap keyframes. In effect, keyframes are the control points that define the splines that govern all animations and dynamics, and, by remapping them, we can dilate time as needed. This enables easy re-use of existing virtual scenes and ensures that new frames do not break any pre-existing animations, as they are simply interpolated between keyframes. An example of this can be seen in Fig. 1 (C, left).
blocks.zh: 为了应对与高速资产作者相关的挑战并克服Blender的最大帧利率限制,我们提议动态地重新绘制密钥帧. 实际上,键框是定义支配所有动画和动态的相线的控制点,通过重新绘制它们,我们可以根据需要扩展时间. 这样可以方便地重新使用已存在的虚拟场景,并确保新帧不会打断任何已存在的动画,因为这些动画仅仅是在键框之间插出. 图1(C,左)中可看出这方面的一例.

blocks.en: S.2.4 Physics engine
blocks.zh: S.2.4 物理发动机

blocks.en: Importantly, the keyframe-remapping technique enables us to take full advantage of Blender’s powerful physics simulation engine. While it is slower than others [ 54 , 3 ] , the Bullet [ 16 ] physics engine is extremely powerful, especially since it can be customized using Blender’s flexible geometry nodes, enabling users to build complex physical systems procedurally. Effects like fluid and cloth simulations, soft or rigid body physics, and more can simply be baked as keyframes and then remapped to any arbitrary frame rate. This enables us to easily create Flying Chairs [ 19 ] -like datasets at much higher frame rates without needing to explicitly tweak the physics sub-time-stepping or collision engine. This is also the same physics engine used by Kubric [ 28 ] , although they manually integrate it into their pipeline using Bullet’s Python API, restricting simulations to only rigid body physics.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,关键框架再绘图技术使我们能够充分利用Blender强大的物理模拟引擎。 虽然它比其他 [54,3] 慢,但Bullet [16] 物理引擎极其强大,特别是因为它可以使用 Blender 灵活的几何节点进行定制,使用户能够在程序上构建复杂的物理系统. 效果如流体和布料模拟,软体或刚体物理等,更多的可以简单地被烘烤成键框并再被重塑到任意的帧速率. 这使得我们能轻松地创建飞行会椅 [19] - 类似帧率高得多的数据集,而不需要明确调整物理分时步法或相撞引擎. 这也是Kubric [28] 使用的同一种物理引擎,尽管他们用Bullet's Python API手动将它集成到他们的管道中,将模拟限制在刚性的身体物理上.

blocks.en: S.2.5 Heat Transport Simulation
blocks.zh: S.2.5 热能运输 模拟

blocks.en: Several sensor modalities of interest—most notably long-wave infrared (LWIR, 8 8 – 14 ​ μ ​ m 14\,\mu\mathrm{m} ) thermal cameras—respond not to the instantaneous radiance leaving a surface, but to the long-wave radiation it emits as a consequence of its temperature, and that temperature is the accumulated result of every watt of power the surface has absorbed over the preceding seconds to hours. Synthesizing a thermal image therefore requires synthesizing a plausible temperature field first, which the sensor emulation layer (Sec. S.5.4 ) then renders into a measurement. To support these modalities, VisionSIM integrates a fast, GPU-accelerated heat-transport solver directly into the world simulation layer, reusing the same Blender asset-authoring and rendering pipeline described above so that the temperature field is always consistent with the exact lighting the scene was authored with. This section develops the forward model in two stages: how absorbed visible light becomes a heat source (Sec. S.2.5.1 ), and how the resulting heat-transport PDE is discretized and solved (Sec. S.2.5.2 ).
blocks.zh: 几种感光法——最引人注目的是长波红外线(LWIR, 8 8 – 14 μ 14\,\ mu\ mathrm{ m})热相机——不与瞬间出出地表的光相相相干,而是与它因温度而出地的长波辐射相干,温度是表面在前几秒钟至数小时所吸收的每一瓦功率的累积结果. 因此,合成热成像首先需要合成一个可行的温度场,然后传感器模拟层(Sec.S.5.4)进行测量。 为了支持这些模式,VisionSIM将一款快速,GPU加速的热能传输解析器直接整合到世界模拟层中,再用上述同一种Blender资产授权并渲染出管道,使温度场始终与场景所创作的准确照明一致. 本节分两个阶段发展出前向模型:被吸收的可见光是如何成为热源的(Sec. S. 2. 5.2.1),以及由此产生的热能运输PDE是如何被磁盘化和解开的(Sec. S. 2. 5.2)。

blocks.en: The decisive modeling choice is that we obtain E E directly from the renderer rather than asking the user to specify a heat flux by hand, as classical FEM packages (ANSYS [ 2 ] , COMSOL [ 15 ] , OpenFOAM [ 67 ] ) require. Concretely, we read E E from the renderer’s diffuse irradiance passes—the direct and indirect diffuse light transport that already produces the matte component of the RGB image, including indirect bounces, environment lighting, sky and sun, and animated emitters—baked into a per-texel irradiance map at each timestep and resampled to mesh vertices by barycentric interpolation. The practical consequence is that the temperature field is always consistent with the exact lighting the scene was authored with: moving the sun to a different time of day moves the heat input, adding an emitter adds a heat source, and turning off a lamp removes its thermal contribution—all without the user authoring any thermal boundary condition.
blocks.zh: 决定性的建模选择是,我们直接从渲染器获得E E,而不是像经典的FEM包(ANSYS [2],COMSOL [15],OpenFOAM [67])要求的那样,要求用户手工指定热通量. 具体地说,我们从渲染器的散射辐射口读出E E—— 已经产生RGB图像的分层部分的直接和间接散射光传输,包括间接回弹、环境照明、天空和太阳以及动画发射器—— 在每个时间步被活化成一幅每吨辐射图,并通过巴以中枢相插再被复制到网格上。 其实际后果是,温度场始终与场景的准确照明一致:将太阳移到不同的白天会移动热输入,增加一个发射器会增加热源,关闭一盏灯会消除它的热能贡献——所有这一切都没有用户作者任何热能边界条件.

blocks.en: A surface-only solve suffices for thin shells (sheet metal, fabric, leaves), but it misrepresents the diffusion pattern for thicker objects, and it fails outright for the hollow meshes common in asset stores: a mug or a skillet modeled as a thin shell conducts heat as if it were a hollow surface rather than a solid body, producing visibly wrong behavior. One way to fix is by tetrahedralizing the interior, but watertight tetrahedralization is unworkable on the open, self-intersecting meshes these assets typically are. We instead work with points rather than tetrahedra. For each closed (or near-closed) object we sample a dense, blue-noise interior point cloud over the bounding box by Bridson Poisson-disk sampling [ 5 ] , keeping only points that pass a BVH ray-parity inside test: a point is interior iff a random ray crosses the surface an odd number of times, and we take a 256 256 -ray majority vote for robustness to degenerate geometry. A mollified point-cloud Laplacian [ 83 ] , built on a k k -nearest-neighbour graph over the combined surface-plus-interior point set, then couples interior diffusion to the boundary degrees of freedom exactly as a volume FEM would, but with no meshing required. In Eq. S7 the indicator 𝟙 ∂ Ω \mathbbm{1}_{\partial\Omega} simply selects the original surface vertices: interior points diffuse but receive no irradiance, radiation, or convection. The resulting sparse systems are assembled and solved on the GPU, keeping the solve fast enough to run in the loop of a dataset-generation pipeline; per-vertex temperatures are written back as a standard Blender attribute that the downstream sensor emulation layer (Sec. S.5.4 ) consumes.

blocks.en: Two modeling choices bound the fidelity of the temperature field. First, we read the absorbed power from the renderer’s diffuse irradiance passes (Eq. S2 ), neglecting the specular component of the incident radiance; since specularly reflected energy is reflected rather than absorbed, attributing it to q abs q_{\mathrm{abs}} causes our heat source to systematically over-estimate the power deposited at glossy surfaces. Second, the mollified Laplacian [ 83 ] built over a k k -nearest-neighbour point set is robust on the open, non-manifold meshes typical of asset stores, but this robustness comes at a cost: no discrete Laplacian can satisfy symmetry, locality, linear precision, and positivity simultaneously [ 101 ] , and the point-cloud solve forgoes the conforming guarantees of a tetrahedral discretization, leaving its accuracy sensitive to point density and to the statistical ray-parity inside/outside test. Richer alternatives such as steady-state walk-on-spheres Monte Carlo estimators are a natural extension and could be plugged in behind the same interface in the future.

blocks.en: Scene flow can be roughly thought of as the 3 3 D analog to optical flow. Instead of the two-dimensional motion field mapping pixel coordinates from one frame to the next, it captures the displacement of scene points in world coordinates.
blocks.zh: 场景流可以被大致认为是3 3 D相模拟到光学流. 取而代之的是从一帧到一帧的二维运动场映射像素坐标,它捕捉了世界坐标中场景点的迁移.

blocks.en: By encoding scene dynamics, this three-dimensional vector field is particularly useful for navigation or robotics tasks, however, historically scene flow datasets have been underrepresented. One of the largest scene flow datasets is the Spring dataset [ 56 ] , which relies on a custom patch of Blender to provide scene flow directly as a render pass.
blocks.zh: 通过编码场景动态,这个三维向量场对于导航或机器人任务特别有用,然而,历史上的场景流数据集代表不足. 最大的场景流数据集之一是"Spring"数据集 [56],它依靠自定义的Blender补丁作为渲染口直接提供场景流.

blocks.en: While this is without a doubt the fastest way to get scene flow, as a by-product of rendering, we cannot make use of it in VisionSIM as it would require the framework to either maintain a custom branch of Blender or force users to compile the patched version themselves.
blocks.zh: 虽然这无疑是获得场景流的最快方式,但作为渲染的副产品,我们不能在VisionSIM中使用它,因为它要求框架要么维持Blender的自定义分支,要么强迫用户自行编译被补丁的版本.

blocks.en: Instead, we opt to compute scene flow using other ground truth annotations which can all be generated using VisionSIM without relying on a custom Blender patch. This significantly reduces the complexity associated with distributing VisionSIM, but has two main downsides.
blocks.zh: 相反,我们选择使用其他地面真实说明来计算场景流,这些记录都可以使用VisionSIM生成,而无需依赖自定义的Blender补丁. 这显著地降低了与发售VisionSIM相关的复杂程度,但主要有两大缺点.

blocks.en: First, scene flow generation is now a post-hoc process, to compute forward flow, the ground truth depth of the next frame needs to be known, and vice-versa for backward flow. Since this process is not causal it has to lag the main rendering process. Currently, VisionSIM opts to compute scene flow exclusively after the render step is complete, to ensure dataset integrity in the event of an irrecoverable crash.
blocks.zh: 第一,场景流生成现在是一个后热过程,用于计算前热流,需要知道下帧的地真深度,反之为后热流. 由于这一过程不是因果,它必须落后于主要渲染过程. 目前,VisionSIM选择完全在渲染步骤完成后计算场景流量,以确保发生不可恢复的崩溃时数据集的完整性.

blocks.en: Second, to generate ground truth flow vectors, Blender needs to know ahead of time where the state of the world at the next (and previous) timestep. The implication is that both optical and scene flow cannot be generated when the user manually positions the camera within the render loop as shown in Fig. 1 (C). Instead, the camera motion needs to be known pre-render, and communicated with Blender via the use of keyframes. In practice, this is seldom a limitation as VisionSIM provides utilities to set camera keyframes before invoking render_animation .
blocks.zh: 第二,为了产生地面真理流向量,Blender需要提前知道下一个(和之前)时间步骤的世界状态. 其含义是,当用户如图1(C)所示手动将相机定位在渲染回圈内时,光学流和场景流都无法生成. 取而代之的是,相机运动需要已知的先发后发,并通过使用键框与Blender通信. 实际上,这很少是一种限制,因为VisionSIM提供公用设施,在援引“动画化”之前设定相机键框。

blocks.en: To compute the forward scene flow S f S_{f} from time t t to t + 1 t+1 we need the point maps P ​ M t PM_{t} , P ​ M t + 1 PM_{t+1} and forward optical flow F f F_{f} for those times. We first get the world coordinates ( x t , y t , z t ) (x_{t},y_{t},z_{t}) for a pixel at time t t using P ​ M t PM_{t} . Then, use F f F_{f} to warp the pixel coordinates from frame t t to their corresponding locations in frame t + 1 t+1 , which yields ( u t + 1 , v t + 1 ) (u_{t+1},v_{t+1}) . We sample P ​ M t + 1 PM_{t+1} at this location and obtain the corresponding world coordinates ( x t + 1 , y t + 1 , z t + 1 ) (x_{t+1},y_{t+1},z_{t+1}) . The difference between these two points in world coordinates is the desired forward scene flow.

blocks.en: S.2.7 Interpolation
blocks.zh: S.2.7 内入

blocks.en: To accurately model high-speed sensors and artifacts such as motion blur, high frame rate data might be needed. While VisionSIM’s distributed architecture, equipped with its powerful keyframe remapping features, allows users to render datasets at arbitrary frame rates, in many cases, this is not needed. Every scene has a native frame rate , beyond which any motion or view-dependent effect becomes imperceptible, wasting additional rendering efforts.
blocks.zh: 为了准确模拟高速传感器和诸如运动模糊等文物,可能需要高帧率数据。 愿景 SIM的分布式架构,配备了强大的键框再映射功能,允许用户以任意的帧速率来制作数据集,在许多情况下,这是不需要的. 每个场景都有原生的帧率,超过此,任何运动或取景效应都变得难以察觉,浪费了额外的渲染努力.

blocks.en: In the real world, sampling the scene much faster than this intrinsic rate is beneficial. It reduces the observed noise and boosts the measured signal. This is especially important in the case of single-photon cameras, which can run at a hundred thousand frames per second, yet each observation encodes very little information — a single bit’s worth in fact [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 在现实世界中,取样速度远快于这种内在速率是有利的。 它能减少所观测到的噪音并增强被测量到的信号. 这对于单相相机来说尤为重要,单相机可以以每秒10万帧的速度运行,然而每个观测数据编码的信息却很少——一分一分实际上值[21].

blocks.en: However, in simulation, we have access to perfect, noise-, and blur-free frames, so there is no need to render redundant data, it suffices to render fast enough and interpolate the rest of the way to reach our desired frame rate. This technique, to render ground truth at some slower rate and fill in the rest, can dramatically cut down on render times for scenes that have low native frame rates. The minimum frame rate at which to render ground truth frames depends entirely on the scene, its geometry, material properties, textures, camera parameters and resolution, and the speed of the scene’s relative motion. In general, the native frame rate is hard to estimate, even in simulations where all parameters are known.
blocks.zh: 然而,在模拟中,我们可以获得完美的,噪音的,和模糊的帧,所以没有必要使冗余数据变得足够快,并插入其他方法达到我们想要的帧率. 这种技术,以较慢的速度使地面真相发生,并填充其余部分,可以大大缩短原生相框率较低的场景的渲染时间。 制作地上真帧的最小帧率完全取决于场景,其几何,材料属性,纹理,相机参数和分辨率,以及场景相对运动的速度. 一般来说,本土帧率很难估计,即使在已知所有参数的模拟中也是如此.

blocks.en: Fortunately, precisely estimating this inflection point is usually not needed. Overshooting means that there will be extra overhead as we are required to render a few additional frames that are near duplicates. On the other hand, if we render slower than the native frame rate, adjacent frames will be more dissimilar. Thankfully, modern deep learning-based video interpolation methods can help fill this gap as they are specifically designed to interpolate between frames that encode large motion. In the limit, when using these methods on frames that have been rendered at or past the native frame rate, adjacent frames are identical and interpolation becomes trivial, effectively devolving into frame duplication. Conversely, when frames are too far apart interpolation will result in noticeable artifacts. Therefore, these interpolation methods give us some leeway in finding the best trade-off between rendering more ground truth frames, at the cost of additional rendering time, and interpolating between wider gaps in the data, which can lead to artifacts.
blocks.zh: 所幸的是,通常不需要准确估计这一差分点。 过度射击意味着,由于我们需要制造几套接近重复的外加相框,所以会有额外的间接费用. 另一方面,如果我们使比本土帧率慢,相邻帧会更相异. 值得庆幸的是,现代深层以学习为基础的视频插入方法可以帮助填补这个空白,因为它们是专门用来在编码大运动的帧之间插入. 在限值中,当使用这些方法在已按或超过本地帧速率制成的帧上使用时,相邻帧是完全相同的,而插入则变得无关紧要,实际上会变成帧重复. 反之,当相框相距太远时,插图将会产生显著的文物. 因此,这些内插方法为我们提供了一些回旋余地,可以找到最佳的取舍,一方面是以额外的渲染时间为代价,提供更多的地基真象框架,另一方面是在数据中更广泛的差距之间进行内插,这可能导致出出出出文物.

blocks.en: In Fig. 1 (B) we rendered a test trajectory at many different frame rates and in each case interpolated the resulting data up to a common frame rate of 6400 6400 fps. We plot the average perceptual similarity between these interpolated frames and ground truth data (lower is better), as well as the total wall time to render and interpolate these different datasets as measured using a single rendering job, on an Nvidia RTX 3080. Notice that the time it takes to interpolate the frames is dwarfed by rendering time. The overall quality of the data improves with higher frame rates and lower interpolation factors, hitting an inflection point around 200 200 fps, after which there are diminishing returns as rendering time explodes. From this, we can see that for this specific scene the native frame rate is around two to four hundred frames per second, and below this rate we incur significant interpolation artifacts, as shown. It takes just under 20 20 minutes to render this scene at 400 400 fps and interpolate it 16 × 16\times to 6.4 6.4 kHz, as compared to over four hours if we rendered every frame.
blocks.zh: 在图1(B)中,我们以许多不同的帧率进行了测试轨迹,并在每种情况下将所得数据插入到6400 6400英尺的通用帧率。 我们绘制了这些插图框架和地面真伪数据之间的平均感知相似性(较低者更好),以及使用单一渲染工作在Nvidia RTX 3080上测量得出这些不同数据集的总墙壁时间。 注意插出相框所需的时间被渲染时间所忽略. 数据的整体质量随着帧率的提高和内插因子的降低而得到提高,撞击了大约200英尺的出错点,之后随着渲染时间的爆炸,回报率不断下降. 我们可以看到,对于这个特定场景, 本地帧率约为每秒两到四百帧, 低于这个速率,我们会产生大量的内插文物, 如所示。 这个场景需要20分钟才能达到400到400英尺, 并插出16×16分,达到6.4克赫兹, 相比之下,如果我们制作每个帧, 则超过4小时。

blocks.en: In practice, one would like to determine the optimal keyframe multiplier K K that achieves this native frame rate automatically. Prior work such as ESIM [ 71 ] addressed this by dynamically triggering a new render whenever the per-pixel optical flow exceeds a fixed threshold. While theoretically appealing, this strategy is difficult to parallelize efficiently and produces non-uniform temporal sampling that is incompatible with many video interpolation methods and sensor modalities. We instead propose a simple yet highly effective closed-form iterative approach. Under the first-order approximation that the optical flow magnitude 𝒱 \mathcal{V} scales as K − 1 K^{-1} — i.e., speeding up the frame rate by K K reduces frame-to-frame motion proportionally — we can estimate the corrected multiplier K i + 1 K_{i+1} needed to scale the flows to a target value 𝒱 t ​ a ​ r ​ g ​ e ​ t \mathcal{V}_{target} : K i + 1 = K i + α i ​ K i ⋅ ( 𝒱 ^ q ​ ( K i ) 𝒱 t ​ a ​ r ​ g ​ e ​ t − 1 ) [ a , b ] . K_{i+1}=K_{i}+\alpha^{i}K_{i}\cdot\left(\frac{\hat{\mathcal{V}}_{q}(K_{i})}{\mathcal{V}_{target}}-1\right)_{[a,b]}\,. When there is no dampening or clamping, this equation reduces to directly scaling the keyframe multiplier by the multiplicative factor, which would — if flow is perfectly inversely proportional to K K — result in the target flow. The added terms help with convergence when this assumption breaks down.

blocks.en: In this way the frame multiplier is set by the scene complexity and speed, through the optical flow proxy, as opposed to by the sensor we wish to emulate. We render at a rate that keeps the 95th-percentile optical flow at a few pixels and interpolate the remaining frames, so the interpolated sequence stays within the tolerance plotted in Fig. 1 (B) of the fully rendered ground truth. Because the rate comes from the per-scene search below rather than a fixed multiplier, it adapts to each trajectory, and a single render supports emulation at any sensor frame rate above it.
blocks.zh: 这样,相框乘以由场景的复杂性和速度设定,通过光学流代用,而不是由我们希望模仿的传感器来设定. 我们以一定的速度使95分光学流保持在几像素上,并插入所剩的相框,所以插入的相序仍停留在图1(B)所描绘的完全渲染出地真象的容能内. 由于速率来自下方的每个场景搜索而不是固定乘数,它适应了每个轨迹,一个单一的渲染支持以任何高于它的传感器帧速率来模拟.

blocks.en: To estimate 𝒱 ^ q ​ ( K 0 ) \hat{\mathcal{V}}_{q}(K_{0}) , we need to render the optical flow of the full trajectory; however, this is much cheaper than rendering the full image frames. Not only can we speed up rendering by using a very low number of samples-per-pixel and disabling auxiliary passes, but we can also render at a proportionally smaller resolution and then scale up the flow fields accordingly. In practice, this technique converges to the desired operating point in just a few iterations, making it inexpensive to execute as a pre-processing pass before any full-scale rendering begins. As an example, on the scene in Fig 1 (B), this technique finds, in just two iterations, that to achieve a 95 95 -percentile flow of less than two pixels we should use a keyframe multiplier of 4.16 4.16 , meaning a native frame rate of 99.8 99.8 fps, perfectly matching up with the inflection point on the plot. Rendering at this frame rate and interpolating up to the target rate of 6400 6400 fps reduces the total simulation time from 4 hours and 3 minutes to just under 4 minutes, a 60 × 60\times speedup.
blocks.zh: 要估算出 V^ q (K 0)\hat\ mathcal{V}}_{q} (K_{0}),我们需要使整个轨迹的光学流;然而,这比制作完整的图像帧要便宜得多. 不仅可以通过使用极低的每像素样本和可失效的辅助通道来加快渲染速度,还可以以比例较小的分辨率来渲染并相应扩大流场. 在实际操作中,这种技术在仅仅几个迭代中汇合到所期望的操作点,使得在任何全面渲染开始前作为预处理通关执行费用低廉. 例如,在图一(B)的现场,这种技术在仅仅两个迭代中发现,为了实现95个95-百分率的流出小于两个像素,我们应该使用4.16 4.16的键框乘法,即99.8 99.8英尺的本生帧率,与地块上的相接点完全匹配. 按这个帧速率进行渲染并被内插到目标速率64006400 fps,将模拟总时间从4小时3分缩短到刚到4分,一个60×60正时速的加速.

blocks.en: Finally, while this method produces substantial speed-ups with little impact on the quality for natural images, it does not work for all modalities. The input images need to be in-distribution for video interpolation methods to work well. Specifically, for non-tone-mapped, high dynamic range images, common methods such as RIFE [ 36 ] or FILM [ 72 ] do not work reliably. In these cases, we can either render every frame or, by also using ground truth depth maps, camera intrinsic, and pose, we can reproject pixels from one frame to a new one. This will cause a different type of artifact, namely bands of missing pixels due to parallax effects, which could be addressed using inpainting or colorization methods [ 92 , 50 ] .
blocks.zh: 最后,虽然这种方法产生巨大的速度,对自然图像的质量影响不大,但它并不适用于所有模式。 输入图像需要进行内部分配,以便视频插入方法运作良好。 具体地说,对于非拓扑出高活性范围图像,常用的方法如RIFE[36]或胶片[72]不可靠. 在这些情况下,我们可以将每个帧制成,或者,也可以通过使用地真地深度图,相机的内在和外形,将像素从一个帧重新投影到一个新的帧. 这将造成一种不同类型的文物,即由截面效应而导致的缺失像素的波段,这些波段可以使用涂抹法或配色法处理[92,50].

blocks.en: S.3 Physically accurate sensor emulation
blocks.zh: S.3 物理精确传感器模拟

blocks.en: At this stage, we have access to high-speed interpolated data, which we will need to further process into the desired sensor modality. Specifically, now that world simulation is done, we perform sensor-realistic emulation for single-photon, high-speed, event, and conventional cameras, along with IMUs. Other camera types could be added by plugging in their image formation model on top of the simulated and interpolated data.
blocks.zh: 在目前阶段,我们可获得高速插值数据,我们需要将这些数据进一步加工入所期望的传感器模式。 具体地说,现在世界模拟工作已经完成了,我们对单相、高速、事件和常规相机以及IMU进行传感器现实模拟。 其他相机类型可以通过在模拟和内插数据上方插入其图像形成模型来添加.

blocks.en: Conventional cameras: While rendered frames are good proxies for what a conventional camera might capture in ideal conditions, in many challenging real-world settings, these are significantly different, and accurate sensor modeling is required [ 11 , 69 ] .
blocks.zh: 常规相机: 虽然制成的相框是传统相机在理想条件下可能捕捉到的好代名词,但在许多具有挑战性的现实世界环境中,这些相框差别很大,需要精确的传感器模型[11,69].

blocks.en: The brightness of a conventional CMOS camera pixel can be modeled as a function of the scene radiance over the exposure time transformed by the camera’s optical stack and response function Γ \Gamma , which encapsulates the camera response curve, tone mapping, quantization, and proprietary image signal processing [ 29 ] . Specifically, over an exposure time τ \tau , a CMOS pixel will accumulate charge, and potentially saturate once it reaches its full well capacity (FWC). This process is subject to many sources of noise, including read noise and photon shot noise, which we absorb into 𝒩 \mathcal{N} .
