blocks.en: To emulate this, we sum together many interpolated intensity frames, discretizing the above integral and creating motion blur. It is important that this discretization be performed at a high frame rate otherwise, the motion blur will not be smooth and will lead to noticeable ghosting artifacts. We then add Gaussian read noise, apply a gain factor representing the sensitivity (ISO), and quantize to a certain bit-depth: the sensor model is adopted from the work of Hasinoff et al. [ 34 ] . More complex effects, such as optical aberrations or fixed pattern noise, can be added here as well.
blocks.zh: 为了效仿这一点,我们总结了许多插入强度框架,将上述整体化并造成运动模糊. 重要的是,要以高帧率进行这种光碟化,否则,运动模糊不会平滑,会导致显着的幽灵文物. 然后加入高斯文读取噪声,应用代表灵敏度(ISO)的增益因子,并量化到一定的位深:从Hasinoff等的作品中采用了传感器模型. [34]. 更复杂的效应,如光学异常或固定的图案噪声,也可以在此被添加.

blocks.en: The camera’s image signal processor (ISP) pipeline involves many computational steps after signal readout, such as de-mosaicing, de-noising, tone-mapping, and compression. The current version of the simulator provides baseline implementations for each of these steps (see methods). Future additions may include 3A algorithm implementations (auto-exposure, auto white-balance, and auto-focus), and recent learning-based imaging pipelines (“neural ISPs”) that are optimized end-to-end.
blocks.zh: 相机的图像信号处理器(ISP)管道在信号读出后涉及许多计算步骤,如去莫色化,去诺色,调色和压缩等. 目前版本的模拟器为其中每个步骤提供了基线执行(见方法). 未来增加的内容可能包括3A算法执行(自动曝光、自动白平衡和自动聚焦),以及最近优化的基于学习的成像管(“神经成像管”)。

blocks.en: High-speed cameras: Usually, also based on CMOS technology, high-speed cameras can be emulated similarly to conventional cameras. However, these suffer from low signal, as the integration time is short, and readout noise that can be an order of magnitude larger than their conventional counterparts 1 1 1 For example Scimedia’s MiCAM03-N256 has readout noise of up to 130 ​ e − 130e^{-} . Thus, we can use the same model, and adapt τ \tau and 𝒩 \mathcal{N} accordingly.
blocks.zh: 高速相机: 通常,同样基于CMOS技术,高速相机可以和常规相机类似地被仿真. 然而,由于集成时间短,信号低,读出噪音可能比常规噪声大。 因此,我们可以使用同样的模型,并相应调整\tau和N\mathcal{N}。

blocks.en: Stereo and multi-view cameras: Stereo cameras enable depth perception by capturing images from two viewpoints with a fixed baseline. We model stereo rigs by spawning two cameras with a fixed offset and intrinsically synchronizing their shutters. This allows for the generation of perfectly aligned stereo pairs and ground-truth disparity maps, which are essential for training and evaluating stereo matching algorithms [ 79 , 56 ] . Multi-view cameras can be modeled similarly by spawning more cameras with different baselines and intrinsics.
blocks.zh: 立体声和多视图相机: 立体相机通过从两个角度取取有固定基线的图像来进行深度感知. 我们模拟立体架, 产出两台相机 固定的相机, 内在的同步 它们的百叶窗。 这使得可以生成完全对齐的立体对和地-真实相差图,这对于培训和评价立体匹配算法[79,56]至关重要. 多视相机同样可以通过产出更多具有不同基线和内在的相机来建模.

blocks.en: Passive single photon cameras: Despite being excellent general purpose imagers, capable of extreme high-speed, low-light, and high-dynamic range imaging [ 44 ] , single-photon cameras remain scarce and expensive. Emulating these cameras can help meet the need for cheap, high-quality, single-photon data and encourage future research.
blocks.zh: 被动单光子相机: 单相相机虽然是出色的通用成像器,能进行极快,低光,高活性能的射程成像[44],但相机依然稀缺而昂贵. 模拟这些相机可以帮助满足对廉价,高质量,单光子数据的需要,并鼓励未来的研究.

blocks.en:
Specifically, we emulate a single-photon avalanche diode-based camera, as these are rapidly becoming mainstream thanks to their CMOS-compatible fabrication process [ 95 ] . These are binary devices that do not suffer from read noise as they are entirely shot-noise-limited. However, SPC pixels reset after a photon detection event, during which no new photons can be detected.
This effectively quantized the pixel’s output, leading it to follow a Bernoulli distribution parameterized by 1 − e − ϕ ​ τ 1-e^{-\phi\tau} [ 21 ] , where ϕ \phi is the scene’s radiant flux. By using the high-speed interpolated frames as a proxy for scene flux, we can emulate an SPC by sampling this distribution. Doing so accurately involves rectifying the tone-mapped frames to their linear intensities and accounting for other non-idealities such as dark count rates or low fill factors. See the supplement for more.
blocks.zh:
具体地说,我们模仿了一款单相机的雪崩二极管相机,因为这些相机由于它们的CMOS相容制造工艺[95]而迅速成为主流. 这些是二进制设备,它们不会受到读取噪声的影响,因为它们是完全有射入噪声限制的. 然而,SPC像素在光子检测事件后重置,在此期间无法检测出新的光子.
这有效地量化了像素的输出,导致它跟随以 1 - e - \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ =\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ 通过将高速内插相框作为场景通量的代名词,我们可以通过取样这种分布来模拟 SPC. 这样做准确地涉及纠正所标出的声音框架,使其达到线性强度,并计算出其他非理想因素,如暗数率或低填充系数。 见补入多.

blocks.en:
Active single-photon cameras: Robust depth perception using direct time-of-flight (dToF) sensors requires a high-fidelity, physically accurate model of an active single-photon camera (ASPC), also commonly known as single-photon LiDAR. We simulate the complete acquisition pipeline, mapping scene irradiance and illumination conditions to noisy photon timestamps.
For each pixel, scene points within the FoV are accumulated and mapped to time-of-flight delays to form the scene response function (SRF). Convolution with the instrument response function (IRF) then models the system’s temporal blur, while ambient illumination is treated as a uniform background rate. Together, these define the per-pixel photon arrival rate, from which discrete photon arrivals are drawn as an inhomogeneous Poisson process.
blocks.zh:
活性单相机 : 使用直取飞行时间(dToF)传感器的强深度感知需要高活性,物理上准确的活性单相相机(ASPC)模型,也通称单相机LiDAR. 我们模拟整个采购管道, 绘图场景辐射 和照明条件 以吵闹的光子时间戳。
对于每个像素,FOV内部的场景点被累积并被映射到飞行时间延迟,以形成场景响应功能(SRF). 与仪器响应函数(IRF)相接,然后模拟系统的时间模糊度,而环境发光被视作一个统一的背景率. 两者共同确定了每像素光子到达率,从中得出离散光子到达率,作为不相干相相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相干相

blocks.en:
In practical single-photon LiDARs, not all photon arrivals are converted to photon detections due to sensor dead time.
We explicitly model the detector’s dead time τ d ​ e ​ a ​ d \tau_{dead} using a non-paralyzable dead time model where photons arriving within the recovery period are discarded. Our implementation can easily be extended to support paralyzable dead time. These functionalities accurately reproduce pile-up distortion, which is essential for emulating physically accurate LiDAR measurements and validating robust estimation algorithms. In addition to simulating raw photon timestamps, the simulator supports both standard Equi-width histogramming (EWH) methods and more recent Equi-depth histogramming (EDH) methods [ 40 , 75 ] .
blocks.zh:
在实用的单发光子LiDARs中,并非所有光子到达者由于传感器死亡时间而转换为光子检测.
使用不可破坏的死亡时间模型, 我们的执行可以很容易地扩大到支持瘫痪的死亡时间。 这些功能准确地复制了堆积扭曲,这对于模拟物理精确的LiDAR测量和验证强力估计算法至关重要. 除了模拟原始光子时间戳外,该模拟器还支持标准的Equi-width直方图法(EWH)和更近期的Equi-深度直方图法[40,75].

blocks.en: Event cameras: By asynchronously emitting per-pixel brightness changes instead of full frames, event cameras are well-suited for many latency-critical applications such as object tracking [ 27 , 58 ] . Our event model follows v2e [ 35 ] . Each pixel applies a probabilistic contrast threshold: a positive or negative event is emitted when the log-intensity change since the last event exceeds the threshold, with the threshold drawn stochastically per event to reproduce the threshold variation measured across a real sensor. The photodiode front end is modeled as a first-order low-pass filter, which sets the bandwidth limit that suppresses events under rapid illumination changes. A centre–surround spatial kernel applied to the pixel’s input reproduces the DVS contrast response. After an event, the pixel is held for a refractory period during which further changes are not reported. These stages take the interpolated high-frame-rate intensity sequence as input, which VisionSIM has already produced, so event emulation runs directly on both rendered and migrated video.
blocks.zh: 事件摄像头 : 通过同步放出每像素的亮度变化而不是全帧,事件相机非常适合许多耐久的关键应用,例如物体跟踪[27,58]. 我们的活动模式遵循v2e [35]. 每个像素都应用概率对比阈值:当日志强度自上次事件超过阈值后发生变化时,会释放出正或负的事件,每起事件的阈值均按下划线来复制通过真实传感器测量的阈值变量. 光二极管前端被建模为一等低通滤波器,它设定了在快速发光变化下压制事件的带宽限制. 适用于像素输入的中心-周边空间内核复制了DVS对比响应. 事件发生后,像素的保存期为可折射期,在此期间不再报告进一步的改变. 这些阶段将插入的高帧强度序列作为输入,VisionSIM已经制作,因此事件模拟直接运行在渲染和迁移的视频上.

blocks.en:
Inertial measurement units: Finally, we model IMUs as they are often co-located with many imaging sensors and are an integral part of many robotics and AR/XR applications where visual-inertial or SLAM-based algorithms may be used. These contain an accelerometer and gyroscope that are modeled by a discrete-time random walk [ 17 , 49 , 24 ] , which introduces both noise and a slow drift away from the camera’s actual linear acceleration and angular velocity, respectively.
The reference values for both are estimated from the ground-truth camera pose sequence through standard numerical differentiation techniques.
The noise standard deviations are set by default to values obtained in previous works in visual-inertial odometry [ 49 ] , but may also be set differently using the datasheet of the sensor to be emulated.
blocks.zh:
惯性测量单元:最后,我们模拟IMU,因为它们常常与许多成像传感器同地办公,并且是许多机器人和AR/XR应用的一个有机组成部分,在这些应用中可以使用视觉惯性或基于SLAM的算法. 这些都包含由离散时间随机行走[17,49,24]所建模的加速计和陀螺仪,它分别引入了噪音和从相机实际线性加速和角速度上走去的缓慢漂移.
两者的参考值都是通过标准数值分化技术从地面-真实相机排列的序列中估算出来的。
噪声标准偏差默认设定为前作在视觉惯性偏振[49]中获得的数值,但也可能使用被模拟的传感器的数据表来不同地设定.

blocks.en: Indirect time-of-flight LiDARs: Indirect time-of-flight (iToF) LiDARs estimate depth by measuring the phase shift or correlation between a modulated light source and the reflected signal [ 48 ] . Unlike dToF sensors that measure individual photon timestamps, iToF sensors typically modulate the active illumination with a periodic coding function—such as a sinusoid, square wave, or more exotic functions [ 32 ] —and record the integrated intensity over several correlation windows. Our simulator supports many common coding functions, enabling the study of different modulation schemes in challenging environments.
blocks.zh: 间接飞行时间 LiDARs:间接飞行时间 (iToF) LiDARs通过测量调制光源与反射信号相位移或相位相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 与测量单个光子时间戳的dToF传感器不同,iToF传感器通常会以定期编码功能来调节活化发光——如sinusoid,平方波等,或更异域功能[32]——并记录多个相關視窗上的综合强度. 我们的模拟器支持许多共同的编码功能,使得能够在有挑战性的环境中研究不同的调制方案.

blocks.en: Thermal cameras: Unlike other modalities, long-wave infrared (LWIR) thermal cameras measure the radiation emitted by a surface due to its temperature. We emulate this by first rendering the temperature field produced by the world simulation’s heat-transport solver into in-band thermal radiance using a physically motivated graybody emission model (Sec. S.5.4.1 ). We then model the temporal dynamics of the dominant commercial LWIR detector, the microbolometer. By filtering the rendered radiance to account for the detector’s thermal inertia, we accurately reproduce the characteristic lag and motion smear of real thermal video (Sec. S.5.4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 热相机: 与其他方式不同,长波红外相机(LWIR)热相机测量地表因温度而排放的辐射. 我们首先将世界模拟的热能传输解析器产生的温度场转化为带内热能辐射,并采用物理动力的灰体排放模型(Sec. S.5.4.1)。 然后我们模拟主要的商业LWIR探测器——微分仪——的时间动态。 通过过滤产生的光度以说明探测器的热惯性,我们准确地复制了真热视频的特征滞后和运动涂片(Sec. S.5.4.2.)。

blocks.en: S.4 Data storage and ML framework integration
blocks.zh: S.4 数据存储和ML框架整合

blocks.en: Once the desired data has been generated, it needs to be stored in a convenient format that enables fast random access and iteration and easily integrates into downstream frameworks. While many such formats exist, we extend the data format informally introduced by NeRFs [ 59 ] to maintain compatibility with existing view synthesis and multi-view reconstruction frameworks such as NeRF-Studio [ 90 ] or COLMAP [ 80 ] . Specifically, we extend this format along two fronts: a sensor-agnostic, and sensor-aware extension.
blocks.zh: 一旦生成所需数据,就需要以方便的格式储存,以便快速随机存取和迭代,并方便地融入下游框架。 尽管存在许多这样的格式,但我们扩展了NERFs[59]非正式引入的数据格式,以保持与NERF-Studio[90]或COLMAP[80]等现有视图合成和多视图重建框架相兼容. 具体地说,我们沿着两个方面扩展这种格式:传感器不可知性和传感器意识扩展。

blocks.en: Both are based around maintaining a transforms.json file which encodes details about the camera’s intrinsic parameters, such as its resolution, focal length and principal point as well as a list of camera poses and asset paths for each instant of the camera trajectory. In its simplest form, these asset paths are just relative paths to the rendered image [ 59 ] . This format can be extended in a sensor-agnostic way, by allowing these asset paths to be more complex to account for other sensor modalities and ground truth annotations. For instance, events are encoded as a stream of ( t , x , y , p ) (t,x,y,p) tuples encoding the time, x/y-coordinates, and polarity of the event, which are saved in a separate file that can be linked to.
blocks.zh: 两者都以维持变换为基础。 编码相机内在参数的json文件, 如分辨率、焦距和主点, 以及相机显示列表和相机轨迹每一瞬间的资产路径 。 最简单的形式来说,这些资产路径只是被渲染出图像的相对路径 [59]. 这种格式可以通过传感器不可知的方式被扩展,允许这些资产路径更为复杂,以考虑到其他传感器模式和地面真实性说明. 例如,事件被编码为一串(t, x, y, p) (t, x, y, p) tuple 编码时间, x/y坐标,以及事件的极性,它们被保存在一个可以链接到的单独文件中.

blocks.en: For single-photon camera data, a sensor-optimized scheme is more appropriate since saving individual single-photon frames can use enormous amounts of storage as image codecs are poorly suited at encoding such highly stochastic data [ 43 ] . Further, many applications, such as Gaussian Splatting [ 46 ] , ingest data at the granularity of pixels instead of full frames, which would require decoding a whole binary frame to sample just a few pixels. This is not an issue when there are only a few hundred images as pixel values can be pre-loaded and cached on the GPU for fast training [ 61 ] , but we quickly run into memory limitations if we attempt to pre-load potentially millions of single photon frames.
blocks.zh: 对于单相相机数据来说,传感器优化方案更合适,因为保存单个单相机帧可以使用大量的存储量,因为图像编码器不适于编码这种高度分解的数据[43]. 此外,许多应用,如高斯平板化[46],在像素的颗粒性而不是全帧上摄取数据,这需要解码一个完整的二进制框架来取取出几个像素. 这不是一个问题,因为像素值只有几百个图像可以被预先装入并缓存到GPU上进行快速训练[61],但是如果我们试图预先装入潜在的上百万个光子帧,我们很快就会遇到内存限制.

blocks.en: To overcome these issues, we store all SPC data as a single large bitpacked numpy array. In this manner, the data is losslessly compressed by 8 × 8\times and can be memory mapped which enables fast random access to the whole dataset. Since the minimum addressable unit of memory is a byte, we are forced to read in a whole byte, whether it represents eight pixels or only one. Thus this compression scheme has virtually no runtime costs, and decompression can be performed on the fly when accessing pixels. VisionSIM abstracts away the tricky bitmasking operations required to perform this compression, instead exposing a high-level API to read and write SPC data directly.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些问题,我们把所有SPC数据存储为单个大的位包数字阵列. 这样,数据会被8×8\times所无损地压缩,并且可以被映射出内存,从而能够快速地随机访问整个数据集. 由于最小可地址的内存单位是一个字节,我们被迫用一个整字节来读取,无论它代表了8个像素还是只有一个像素. 因此,这种压缩方案几乎没有运行时间成本,在访问像素时可以在苍蝇上进行去压缩. VisionSIM摘要删除了进行这种压缩所需的棘手的比特拼接操作,取而代之的是曝光一个高级API直接读取和写入SPC数据.

blocks.en: For both these formats, VisionSIM provides data-loading utilities that can directly be used with modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow to train machine learning models.
blocks.zh: 对于这两种格式,VisionSIM提供了可以直接与PyTorch或TensorFlow等现代深层学习框架一起用于培训机器学习模型的数据加载功能.

blocks.en: S.5 Forward models and implementation details for selected sensors
blocks.zh: S.5 某些传感器的推进模型和实施细节

blocks.en: S.5.1 Emulating single-photon cameras
blocks.zh: S.5.1 模拟单相机

blocks.en: Assuming constant flux during the exposure time, the number of photons incident on a pixel during an exposure time τ \tau follows a Poisson distribution parameterized by the total incident light during that exposure, namely ϕ ​ τ \phi\tau , where ϕ \phi is the scene’s radiant flux. A SPAD-based SPC does not suffer from read noise; however, its pixels reset after a photon detection event, during which no new photons can be detected. This quantizes the pixel’s output, leading it to follow a Bernoulli distribution with parameter 1 − e − ϕ ​ τ 1-e^{-\phi\tau} [ 21 ] .

Therefore, SPC can be emulated by Bernoulli sampling the interpolated intensity frames. However, the ground truth frames do not encode scene flux; they encode the scene’s intensity, often non linearly. We must first ensure the frames are in a linear colorspace, either by generating them as such or undoing any tone mapping that may have been applied. This intensity then needs to be mapped to scene flux; however, up until now, there has been no concept of scene brightness in absolute terms. While a user can set the power of every light source in Blender, this does not translate directly to physical units. Instead, we introduce a correction factor f f that maps a pixel’s linear intensity to a flux value, absorbing into it any non-idealities such as dark count rates or low fill factors.
blocks.zh: 因此,由Bernoulli对插入的强度框架进行取样,可以仿效SPC. 但是,地面的真象框没有编码场景通量;它们编码了场景的强度,往往是非线性地. 我们必须首先确保框架处于线性色相空间中,要么通过生成它们本身,要么撤销可能应用过的任何音调映射。 因此,这种强度需要绘制成场通量图;然而,到目前为止,还没有绝对的场景亮度概念。 虽然一个用户可以设定Blender中每个光源的功率,但这并不能直接翻译为物理单位. 相反,我们引入了一个将像素的线性强度映射到通量值的校正因子f,吸收了任何非理想因素,如暗数率或低填充因子.

blocks.en: S.5.2 Active single-photon camera modeling
blocks.zh: 页:1 活性单相机建模

blocks.en: Robust depth perception using direct time-of-flight (dToF) sensors requires training data that captures the nuances of real-world hardware. To this end, our simulator implements a high-fidelity model of an Active Single-Photon Camera (ASPC) that goes beyond the noise-free depth abstractions of standard game engines. We simulate the complete acquisition pipeline, mapping scene irradiance to noisy photon timestamps, while also modeling on-sensor compression schemes critical for resource-constrained applications like autonomous robots and AR/VR headsets. We discuss the forward imaging model in Section 4.1 . In this section, explain it in detail along with the implementation details.
blocks.zh: 使用直接飞行时间传感器的强深度感知需要能够捕捉到真实世界硬件细微分辨的训练数据. 为此,我们的模拟器实施了一个活性单相机(ASPC)的高真度模型,它超越了标准游戏引擎的无噪声深度抽象. 我们模拟完整的收购管道,绘制场景辐照到吵闹的光子时间戳,同时模拟对资源受限的应用至关重要的感光压缩方案,如自主机器人和AR/VR头盔. 我们在4.1节中讨论前向成像模型。 在本节中,结合执行细节详细解释。

blocks.en: The forward imaging model can be divided into three main stages: (i) computing the photon-transient, which models the geometric and radiometric scene properties, (ii) computing the photon arrival rates, which models the active and ambient light sources, and (iii) computing the LiDAR measurements, which models pileup distortion, compressed readouts, the effect of TDC resolution, and synchronous or free-running mode of operation of SPAD sensors.

blocks.en: To transform continuous photon rates into discrete digital measurements, VisionSIM models the stochastic behavior of sensor electronics along with realistic hardware readout schemes. We explicitly incorporate a non-paralyzable dead time ( τ d ​ e ​ a ​ d \tau_{dead} ) model to simulate the non-linear pileup distortions typically observed when operating in high-flux scenarios. We support two different on-sensor compression methods: (i) standard equi-width histogramming (EWH), which aggregates arrivals into fixed temporal intervals, used in conventional LiDARs, and (ii) equi-depth histogramming (EDH). Designed to mitigate bandwidth constraints in high-resolution arrays, EDH utilizes adaptive quantization to dynamically vary bin widths based on local photon density, preserving high temporal resolution for sharp, peaky distributions while compressing sparse background noise. blocks.en: PyTorch implementation with unit-aware configuration system
blocks.zh: PyTorch 安装单元感知配置系统

blocks.en: The simulator is implemented entirely in PyTorch, prioritizing modularity and vectorized operations. By representing the sensor measurements as a high-dimensional tensor, we leverage massive parallel operations. Unlike CPU-bound simulators that iterate over pixels, our vectorized implementation processes mega-pixel arrays simultaneously on the GPU, significantly reducing the simulation time for dense SPAD arrays.
blocks.zh: 模拟器完全由PyTorch执行,优先使用模块化和向量化操作. 通过将传感器测量值作为高维分光仪来表示,我们利用了大规模的平行操作。 与超像素的CPU捆绑模拟器不同,我们的矢量化执行过程是巨型像素阵列同时在GPU上进行,大大缩短了密集SPAD阵列的模拟时间.

blocks.en: Unlike rigid legacy simulators, our framework utilizes a strict, unit-aware configuration system (powered by pint and ruamel.yaml ). This ensures that all simulation parameters, from laser power (Watts) to pixel pitch (Micrometers), are dimensionally consistent, eliminating physical unit errors before runtime.
blocks.zh: 与僵硬的遗产模拟器不同,我们的框架采用了严格的单元意识配置系统(由品脱和ruamel.yaml驱动)。 这确保所有从激光功率(Watts)到像素投出(Micrimeters)的模拟参数在维度上一致,在运行时间之前消除物理单位出错.

blocks.en: Another distinguishing feature of our framework is the fully differentiable execution modes, which use PyTorch’s autograd functionality. This formulation allows gradients to flow from the downstream task loss (e.g., depth reconstruction error) back to the sensor parameters. This enables end-to-end optimization of hardware parameters, such as the sensor IRF or dead time.
blocks.zh: 我们框架的另一个显著特征是完全不同的执行模式,它们使用PyTorch的自动分级功能。 这种配方允许梯度从下游任务损失(如深度重建出错)回流到传感器参数. 这使得硬件参数的端到端优化成为可能,例如传感器IRF或死时.

blocks.en: S.5.2.2 Physically Constrained Single Photon LiDAR Simulations using VisionSIM
blocks.zh: 第5.2.2条 物理限制单光子 LiDAR 使用 VisionSIM 模拟

blocks.en:
Our goal with VisionSIM is to bridge the sim-to-real gap, and to do so, we need to be able to model sensor physics realistically. The reason conventional simulators fail to do this is that they create ideal, high-resolution depth maps from scene data. They fail to model limitations in sensor performance as we show in Fig. 3 ( A , B , C , D ). The tradeoff between bandwidth and resolution is something every single-photon LiDAR designer needs to consider when developing a system. Lowering spatiotemporal resolution offers a balance between the data bottleneck and fidelity. However, to evaluate the design choices, conventional simulators use techniques such as artificial quantization and resize-interpolation, which do not adequately
model the physical world. VisionSIM enables physically accurate emulation of realistic sensor and optical properties. Complex optical effects can be modeled using per-pixel FOV masks, shown in Fig. 3 ( E ), including vignetting, a process largely ignored by conventional simulators. The FOV masks also allow us to emulate sensors of varying spatiotemporal resolution while retaining a physically accurate acquisition model (Fig. 3 F , H ).

blocks.en: VisionSIM includes environment non-idealities during acquisition, such as noise from ambient light (Fig. 3 G ) as well as non-idealities unique to this modality. One example of this stems from the implications of dead time. This is a requirement of these sensors because their ability to detect single photons stems from their high sensitivity to energy introduced to the system. They require time to return to an equilibrium state before additional detections. An unavoidable problem arises from this physical process, which is known as pileup. Pileup occurs when photons are not detected during a SPAD’s dead time, which leads to two problems. Firstly, photon counts are underestimated. Secondly, these early detections bias the sensor towards earlier timing bins and can cause a reported depth to be lower than an object’s true depth (referred to as range-walk error) as demonstrated in Suppl. Fig. 3 .
blocks.zh: VisionSIM包括获取过程中的环境非理想性,例如来自环境光(图3G)的噪音以及这种模式所特有的非理想性. 这方面的一个例子来自死亡时间的影响。 这是这些传感器的一项要求,因为它们能够探测出单光子,因为它们对引入系统的能量高度敏感。 它们需要时间回到平衡状态,然后才能得到更多的检测。 这种被称为堆积的物理过程产生了一个不可避免的问题。 在SPAD死后没有检测出光子时,便会出现皮勒普现象,这导致了两个问题. 首先,光子计数被低估。 其次,这些早期检测使传感器偏向于更早的计时箱,并可能导致报告的深度低于一个物体的真实深度(称为射程-行走出错),如Supp.Fig. 3所示。

blocks.en: However, real-world iToF systems are highly susceptible to physical non-idealities and environmental factors that conventional computer vision simulators fail to model. VisionSIM addresses this gap by implementing physically accurate emulation of these effects, enabling the validation of downstream depth estimation algorithms under realistic conditions. As shown in the bottom row of Fig. 2 , we simulate several critical iToF failure cases and demonstrate their direct impact on depth reconstruction. All examples in the figure are the result of varying a single simulation parameter, and these effects can of course be combined:
blocks.zh: 然而,现实世界 iToF系统极易受到传统计算机视觉模拟器无法建模的物理非理想和环境因素的影响. VisionSIM通过从物理上准确模拟这些影响来弥补这一差距,从而能够在现实条件下验证下游深度估计算法。 正如图2的下行所示,我们模拟了几起关键的iToF故障案例,并显示了它们对深度重建的直接影响. 图中的所有例子都是单个模拟参数变化的结果,这些效果当然可以合并:

blocks.en: • Incorrect Modulation Frequency: The modulation frequency defines the unambiguous depth range of the sensor. In the figure, the incorrect modulation frequency uses 35 35 MHz (yielding an unambiguous depth of only ∼ \scriptstyle\sim 4.3 4.3 meters, which is not enough for the scene). The phase wraps around, causing severe phase wrapping ambiguities where distant objects appear deceptively close. • Sensor Saturation: When the exposure time is too long, or an object is highly reflective or positioned too close to the active light source, the accumulated charge can exceed the sensor’s full well capacity. This saturates the pixel and corrupts the correlation measurements. Here, clipping occurs because the full well capacity of 50 50 k electrons is exceeded. This injects non-linear distortions that corrupt the reconstructed depth (notice the front row chairs and ceiling lamps). • Ambient Light Corruption: Strong background illumination introduces a significant DC offset to all taps. In this example, the ambient light level is raised to match the power of the active source. This degrades the modulation contrast and signal-to-noise ratio, leading to incorrect depth reconstruction, particularly for distant objects as they are more dimly illuminated by the active source. • Motion Blur: Because iToF systems must sequentially capture multiple frames (taps) to reconstruct a single depth map, any relative motion between the camera and the scene during the acquisition sequence leads to multi-tap motion artifacts. For this example, motion blur happens over 100 100 ms. VisionSIM simulates this effect by temporally offsetting the frames used for each tap, accurately reproducing the resulting depth tearing and ghosting at object boundaries. • Sensor Noise and Quantization: We model physical noise sources such as shot noise and read noise, alongside the finite resolution of the analog-to-digital converters (quantization). In the figure, the noise corresponds to shot noise plus a read noise of 10 ​ e − 10e^{-} and a 12 12 -bit ADC. These factors lead to high-frequency depth noise and quantization banding in the reconstructed depth map. By modeling these physical degradation processes, VisionSIM provides a reliable playground for developing and stress-testing robust phase-unwrapping, de-noising, and high-dynamic-range iToF depth reconstruction pipelines.

blocks.en: S.5.4 Thermal Cameras
blocks.zh: S.5.4 热相机

blocks.en: Long-wave infrared (LWIR, 8 8 – 14 ​ μ ​ m 14\,\mu\mathrm{m} ) thermal cameras occupy a fundamentally different place in the imaging stack than the other modalities in VisionSIM: rather than measuring light scattered off the scene within the last microseconds, they measure the long-wave radiation a surface emits as a consequence of its temperature. The world simulation layer supplies that temperature field through the integrated heat-transport solver (Sec. S.2.5.2 ); here we describe how the sensor emulation layer turns it into a measurement in two stages: rendering the temperature field into in-band thermal radiance with a graybody shader (Sec. S.5.4.1 ), and applying the microbolometer image-formation model whose thermal inertia gives real LWIR video its characteristic lag and smear (Sec. S.5.4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 长波红外线(LWIR, 8 8 – 14 μ 14\,\ mu\ mathrm{ m})热相机在成像堆中占据了与VisionSIM中其他模式根本不同的位置:它们不是测量最后几微秒内散出场外的光线,而是测量出一出地表辐射的长波辐射量,这是其温度的结果. 世界模拟地层通过综合热能迁移解析器提供温度场(Sec.S.2.5.2);在这里,我们描述传感器模拟地层如何将其转化为分两个阶段的测量:用灰色体遮蔽器(Sec.S.5.4.1)将温度场转化为带内热能辐射(S.5.4.1),并应用微分仪成像成形模型,其热惯性使真实的LWIR视频具有其特征滞后和涂抹(S.5.4.2)。

blocks.en: S.5.4.1 Rendering the Temperature Field into Thermal Radiance
blocks.zh: 第5.4.1号决议 将温度场变成热辐射

blocks.en: The solver produces a per-vertex temperature field, which is not yet an image. To turn it into the in-band radiance a thermal camera would collect, we render the scene with a physically motivated graybody emission model. Rather than maintaining a separate thermal copy of the scene, we render thermal imagery from the same scene, camera, and animation as the RGB render by toggling a small set of scene-level overrides—swapping each material for its thermal counterpart, and by disabling visible-band lamps which an LWIR camera does not see. This guarantees that the RGB and thermal images are pixel-aligned and that any edit to the scene propagates to both modalities.
blocks.zh: 解析器产生一个反相温度场,这个温度场还不是图像. 为了把它变成一个热相机所收集的波段光度, 我们用一个具有物理动力的灰体排放模型来制造场景。 我们不是保持一个单独的场景热复制品,而是制作与RGB渲染的同一场景、相机和动画的热成像,其方法是绘制出一套小的场景层面的覆盖图案——为热能对应物刷出每一件材料,并拆除LWIR相机看不到的可见带灯。 这保证了RGB和热成像图象是像素相通的,任何编辑到场景都会向两种模式传播.

blocks.en: At LWIR wavelengths each surface radiates as an opaque graybody, contributing both its own thermal emission within the camera’s sensitivity band and a reflection of the long-wave radiation arriving from the rest of the scene. We model the outgoing in-band radiance at 𝐱 \mathbf{x} as L out ​ ( 𝐱 ) = ϵ ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) ​ U ​ ( T ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) ) + ( 1 − ϵ ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) ) ​ L in ​ ( 𝐱 ) , L_{\mathrm{out}}(\mathbf{x})\;=\;\epsilon(\mathbf{x})\,U\!\big(T(\mathbf{x})\big)\;+\;\big(1-\epsilon(\mathbf{x})\big)\,L_{\mathrm{in}}(\mathbf{x}), (S15) where T ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) T(\mathbf{x}) is the surface temperature from the heat solver, ϵ ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \epsilon(\mathbf{x})\in[0,1] is the LWIR emissivity, L in ​ ( 𝐱 ) L_{\mathrm{in}}(\mathbf{x}) is the incident long-wave radiance gathered from the rest of the scene [ 62 ] , and U ⁡ ( T ) U(T) is the camera response to a blackbody at temperature T T , obtained by integrating Planck’s law against the camera’s spectral response and generally well-approximated by the Sakuma–Hattori model [ 76 , 62 ] . The first term is the graybody emission within the LWIR specturm, scaled by emissivity through Kirchhoff’s law; the second is its conjugate reflection, weighted by 1 − ϵ 1-\epsilon , which is exactly the reflectivity an opaque graybody assigns by energy conservation. Although the angular reflectance of real materials in the 8 8 – 14 ​ μ ​ m 14\,\mu\mathrm{m} band is not as well characterized as in the visible, we adopt a Lambertian BRDF for the reflected term: it is the canonical choice for a graybody, keeps the model fully determined by the single per-surface parameter ϵ \epsilon , and is straightforwardly replaceable by a measured wavelength-specific BRDF as the literature matures. The two terms together capture the qualitative behavior of real LWIR imagery without any material-specific special cases: a polished low- ϵ \epsilon metal “looks cold” because its mix weights the reflection of its cooler surroundings, while a high- ϵ \epsilon matte surface reads its own emitted light almost directly.

blocks.en: S.5.4.2 Microbolometer Thermal Inertia
blocks.zh: S.5.4.2 微血压计热能

blocks.en: A real uncooled LWIR camera does not record the instantaneous in-band radiance produced by the renderer. The dominant commercial LWIR detector is the microbolometer : an array of thermally isolated absorber membranes, one per pixel, whose temperature is set by the incident radiation and read out as an electrical resistance. Because the membrane has finite heat capacity, its temperature cannot change instantly with the incident radiation; the readout instead lags behind, and that lag is what gives real thermal video its characteristic motion smear and ghost trails behind moving hot objects [ 85 ] .

blocks.en: For this evaluation we captured the real scene using an off-the-shelf, commercial, single photon LiDAR developed by ADAPs Photonics [ 1 ] (the ADS6311) used because it gives access to raw unprocessed histograms. This device has a dead-time of ∼ 11 {\raise 0.73193pt\hbox{$\scriptstyle\sim$}}11 ns and a temporal resolution of 754 754 ps. The transmitter uses VCSEL laser diodes to scan a 6-row-wide band in the vertical direction.

blocks.en: We set up a scene in lab with a retroreflective stop sign. Retroreflector’s send incident light back towards its source resulting in two phenomena: pileup and glare (referred to as bloom in the LiDAR community). Pileup is the result of a SPAD element’s ”dead-time” which biases the sensor toward earlier detections. In the event of strong returns such as those from a retroreflector, this bias is strengthened which leads to what is referred as range walk error (an error in the measured depth) as well as a reduction in measured intensity (due to photons in later time bins being missed). In addition to causing pileup, some of the returning waveform scatters diffusely on the lens as well as bouncing between the lens, receiver housing, and pixel array which all lead to spurious detections. This is the cause of what is known as glare or bloom (in traditional CMOS imaging this is sometimes called lens flare).
blocks.zh: 我们在实验室里设置了一个场景 上面有一个反射的站牌 反光反应者将事件光发回源头, Pileup是SPAD元素"死时"的结果, 如果出现强烈的回溯器等回报,这种偏差会得到加强,从而导致被称作射程行走错误(被测量深度的误差)和被测量强度的降低(因为后期的光子被忽略了). 除了引起堆积外,一些还原的波形散射到镜头上,并弹出镜头之间,接收机外壳和像素阵列,都会导致虚假的探测. 这就是被称作"光"或"花"的原因(在传统的CMOS成像中,这有时被称为"镜头耀斑").

blocks.en: We then reconstructed this scene in Blender with the stop sign and background at roughly the same depth and dimensions. blocks.en: To simulate the glare artifacts we measured the PSF function of the ADS6311 by disabling the transmitter and pointing an IR flashlight at the same wavelength toward the receiver. We used a small aperture and baffle to ensure light was incident on a single pixel and that there were no multipath effects being measured respectively. These 49 measured PSF’s are treated as a basis, with remaining positions interpolated by a distance-weighted sum of the 49 measured positions. We plan to add more robust lens modeling that includes a parametric form of this glare model and can be learned in a similar fashion to the IRF learning described in section S.6.3 . Error maps for each additional modeled effect (IRF, pileup, and bloom) can be found in Figure 4 . It should be noted that the discrepancy between the reported RMSE from the main paper and this figure is due to a tighter crop around the region of interest. This is in part to highlight the effects of our realistic modeling but also because the background tarp was the most challenging to match in Blender, causing error unrelated to VisionSIMs physical model but instead due to imperfections in how the ground truth depth was calculated for the tarp in Blender.
blocks.zh: 为了模拟光亮的文物,我们测量了ADS6311的PSF功能,使发射机失效,并将一个IR闪光灯指向接收器的同波长. 我们用一个小孔径和花纹来保证光线在一像素上发生,并且没有分别测量多路径效应. 这49个经测量的PSF作为依据,其余位置由49个经测量位置的相距加权总和相插。 我们计划增加更坚固的透镜模型,包括这种光镜模型的参数化形式,并且可以类似于S.6.3节所描述的IRF学习方式学习. 每种附加模型效果(IRF,堆放和开花)的错误图可见于图4. 应当指出的是,所报告的RMSE与主要文件之间的差异与这一数字之间有出入,原因是有关区域的作物收紧了。 这部分是为了强调我们现实的模型设计的效果,但也因为背景油布在Blender中最难匹配,造成与VisionSIMS物理模型无关的错误,而是由于Blender中油布的地面真实深度计算不完善。

blocks.en: Asset curation. To help accelerate research, we release all 3 3 D assets and scripts used to create sensor-realistic datasets, lowering the need for manual asset curation, which can be a significant hurdle. Specifically, we release the 100 100 high-quality rigged scenes, some of which are shown in Fig. 5 , which have been used to create the VisionSIM dataset. These scenes have mostly been crowdsourced from sites such as BlendSwap [ 60 ] or Blender’s example scenes [ 4 ] , although some have been made or heavily modified specifically for this use case. All scenes are fully rigged, physics-baked, and validated to render without modification using the Blender version pinned to the corresponding VisionSIM release. These assets are released under the Creative Commons license (CC BY 4.0) or similar permissive licenses.
blocks.zh: 资产管理。 为了帮助加速研究,我们释放了用于创建传感器-现实化数据集的所有3个3D资产和脚本,降低了人工资产校正的需求,这可能是个重大障碍. 具体地说,我们发布了100个高品质被操纵的场景,其中的一些场景在图5中显示,这些场景被用于创建VisionSIM数据集. 这些场景大多来自BlendSwap [60] 或 Blender 的例子场景[4]等网站,尽管有些场景是专门为这个使用案例而制作或大量修改的. 所有场景都是完全操纵的,物理封存的,并使用被绑在相应VisionSIM发行的Blender版本进行验证,无需修改即可渲染. 这些资产是根据创用CC BY 4.0许可或类似许可发放的。

blocks.en: Generation pipeline. Dataset generation is driven by a single script, scripts/mkdataset.py , that wraps the same RenderConfig dataclass and render_animation backend used throughout VisionSIM’s CLI. A user specifies a directory of blend-files and an output directory; the script then (i) uniformly samples non-overlapping sub-trajectories from the animation range of each scene, or renders the whole trajectory if desired, (ii) dispatches each (scene, trajectory) pair as an asynchronous render job via BlenderClients.pool , and (iii) saves every sequence under a deterministic path which also contains the explicit configuration used to produce the sequence. All relevant metadata are stored in per-modality SQLite databases alongside the raw data. The RenderConfig dataclass exposes every relevant parameter — resolution, render device, keyframe multiplier, types of ground truth, noise threshold, and per-modality flags — entirely through the CLI, so a full reconfiguration of the dataset requires no code changes. For example, to render a 800 × 800 800\times 800 dataset at 100 100 fps with depth, normals, optical flow, and segmentation using five parallel jobs:
blocks.zh: 生成管道。 数据集生成由单一脚本,脚本/mkdataset.py所驱动,该脚本将相同的RenderConfig数据类包裹在一起并渲染出整个VisionSIM的CLI中使用的活化后端. 用户指定了混合文件目录和输出目录;然后脚本(一) 从每个场景的动画范围统一取出非重叠子导出,或者在需要时使整个出轨,(二) 通过 BlenderClients.pool 将每个出轨(场面,轨迹)成对作为同步渲染任务,(三) 将每个序列保存在决定性路径下,该路径还包含用于生成序列的明确配置. 所有相关元数据与原始数据一起存储在每个模式的SQLite数据库中. RenderConfig数据类将每个相关的参数——分辨率,渲染设备,键框乘数,地真类型,噪声阈值,和每模式旗——全部通过CLI进行曝光,因此数据集的全面重组不需要代码更改. 例如,利用5个平行工作,在100英尺的深度、常态、光学流动和分化条件下,制作800×800800分秒的800数据集:

blocks.en: Reproducibility. Every VisionSIM release is containerized with Docker [ 57 ] and tested end-to-end in CI, ensuring that a pinned version of the library and its container can regenerate all data without any environment configuration. Users who wish to reproduce or modify the dataset only need to (i) pull the versioned Docker image corresponding to the release tag, (ii) obtain the released blend-files, and (iii) invoke mkdataset.py with the published configuration.
blocks.zh: 发相相. 每个愿景SIM 释放与多克 [57] 被容器并测试端到端在 CI 中,确保一个被绑定的版本库及其容器可以在没有任何环境配置的情况下再生出所有数据. 希望复制或修改数据集的用户只需要(一) 取出与发布标记相对应的已版本的多克克图像,(二) 获得已发布的混合文件,(三) 用已发布的配置来引用mkdataset.py.
